instruction: Ninanunua saruji (cement) na nondo (steel bars) kwa ujenzi — VAT withholding ni asilimia ngapi?
output: Vifaa vya ujenzi kama saruji na nondo ni BIDHAA (goods) — kwa hivyo VAT withholding ni 3% (si 6%). Kanuni ya msingi ya withholding wa VAT: BIDHAA → 3%; HUDUMA → 6%. Malipo ya VAT withholding yanafanywa na mnunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying buyer) kutoka jumla ya bei inayolipwa kwa muuzaji. Kumbuka: withholding certificate lazima itolewa siku VAT inakuwa ya kulipwa — si tarehe ya 20 (ambayo ni tarehe ya kuwasilisha VAT return tofauti). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: STR ina zana gani kuu 4 za biashara?
answer_sw: STR ina zana 4 kuu: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — hati inayothibitisha asili ya bidhaa; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — fomu rahisi ya forodha badala ya fomu ngumu; (3) Common List — orodha ya bidhaa ~370 zinazostahili STR; (4) Kizingiti cha USD 2,000 — mipaka ya thamani ya msafara.
question_en: What are the 4 main STR instruments?
answer_en: STR has 4 main instruments: (1) Simplified Certificate of Origin (SCO) — a document certifying the origin of goods; (2) Simplified Customs Document (SCD) — a simplified customs form instead of complex forms; (3) Common List — list of ~370 eligible goods; (4) USD 2,000 threshold — the consignment value limit.

instruction: Malipo ya NSSF yanawasilishwa TRA au NSSF moja kwa moja?
output: Malipo ya NSSF yanawasilishwa moja kwa moja kwa NSSF — si TRA. NSSF ina mfumo wake wa ukusanyaji. Mwajiri anaweza kulipa kupitia benki au mtandaoni kupitia mfumo wa NSSF (nssf.go.tz). Tofauti na PAYE na SDL ambazo zinakwenda TRA, NSSF inakwenda shirika lake la mfuko wa pensheni. Hakikisha unapeleka malipo kwenye akaunti sahihi ya NSSF.

question_sw: Ongezeko la mshahara wa GN 605A lilikuwa asilimia 20 kwa wastani — je, hii ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Ongezeko la wastani lilikuwa asilimia 33.4 — si asilimia 20. Mshahara wa wastani uliongezeka kutoka Shilingi 275,060 hadi Shilingi 358,322. Ongezeko la asilimia 20 lingekuwa likifikia tu Shilingi 330,072 — namba hiyo si sahihi.
question_en: The GN 605A wage increase was 20% on average — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The average increase was 33.4% — not 20%. The average minimum wage rose from TZS 275,060 to TZS 358,322. A 20% increase would have reached only TZS 330,072 — that figure is incorrect.

question_sw: Je, biashara ya simu (phone credit / airtime) inahitaji EFD?
answer_sw: Biashara ya kuuza airtime (simu za prepaid) iliyosajiliwa kwa VAT inahitaji EFD. Hata hivyo, mengi ya mawakala wa kuuza airtime (airtime resellers) wanafanya kazi kwa mfumo wa wakala ambapo wanauza bidhaa za kampuni za simu — hali yao ya VAT/EFD inategemea muundo wa biashara na mauzo ya jumla. Kama mauzo yako yanazidi kizingiti cha VAT, usajili na EFD ni lazima. Wasiliana na TRA.
question_en: Does an airtime/phone credit business need an EFD?
answer_en: An airtime (prepaid phone credit) business that is VAT-registered requires EFD. However, many airtime resellers operate as agents selling telecom company products — their VAT/EFD status depends on business structure and total sales. If your sales exceed the VAT threshold, VAT registration and EFD are mandatory. Contact TRA for your specific situation.

instruction: SDL inaanzia kwa wafanyakazi wangapi?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kizingiti: wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi kwa wakati mmoja. Wafanyakazi 9: SDL haihitajiki (bado chini ya kizingiti). Wafanyakazi 10: SDL inahitajika — anza kulipa mara moja.

question_sw: Wakala wa zuio (withholding agent) ni nani Tanzania?
answer_sw: Wakala wa zuio ni mtu anayehitajika kisheria kukata kodi ya zuio kutoka kwa malipo anayofanya. Wakala wa zuio ni: serikali na taasisi zake, makampuni, na watu binafsi waliotajwa na sheria. Wakala anapaswa kusajiliwa TRA na kulipa ndani ya siku 7. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: Who is a withholding agent in Tanzania?
answer_en: A withholding agent is a person legally required to deduct withholding tax from payments they make. Withholding agents include: government and its institutions, companies, and specified individuals. The agent must be registered with TRA and pay within 7 days. Confirm with TRA.

Hata hivyo, ikiwa programu ina uvumbuzi wa kipekee unaostahili hataza (patent), unaweza kuchunguza usajili wa hataza kupitia BRELA. instruction: Ninanunua nyumba Tanzania — stamp duty inahesabiwaje na ni kiasi gani nalazima nilipe?
output: Stamp duty inatumika kwa uhamisho wa mali Tanzania. Viwango na taratibu halisi vinategemea aina ya mali na thamani yake inayotathminiwa na mthamini aliyesajiliwa. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara. Stamp duty kwa uhamisho wa mali (property transfer) inashughulikiwa na Ofisi ya Ardhi (Ministry of Lands) na inahitaji tathmini maalum ya thamani ya mali. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu, Ofisi ya Ardhi, au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Je, mgeni mwenye uraia wa nchi mbili -- mmoja ni Tanzania -- anakabiliwa na GN 487A?
output: Kama mtu ana uraia wa Tanzania chini ya Sheria ya Uraia Cap.357 (kwa kuzaliwa, nasaba, au kuasiliwa), kwa kawaida anachukuliwa raia wa Tanzania -- si mgeni -- kwa madhumuni ya GN 487A. Hata hivyo, hali za uraia mbili ni za kisheria ngumu. Thibitisha hali yako maalum na wakili wa uhamiaji na Idara ya Uhamiaji kabla ya kufanya maamuzi ya biashara.

question_sw: Ardhi ya kilimo (agricultural land) ina kiwango tofauti cha ushuru wa stempu kuliko ardhi ya makazi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu Tanzania inaweza kuwa na tofauti za ushuru kulingana na aina ya ardhi au matumizi yake. Kwa ujumla, kiwango cha kawaida cha asilimia 1 kinatumika kwa aina nyingi za ardhi. Msamaha au kupunguzwa kwa ushuru kwa ardhi ya kilimo unaweza kutegemea masharti mahususi ya kisheria. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa aina yako ya ardhi.
question_en: Does agricultural land have a different stamp duty rate than residential land in Tanzania?
answer_en: The Tanzania Stamp Duty Act may have variations based on type of land or its use. Generally, the standard 1% rate applies to most land types. An exemption or reduction for agricultural land may depend on specific legal conditions. Check TRA directly for your type of land.

instruction: Mrithi wangu atakapourithi duka langu baada yangu — kuna capital gains tax kwake?
output: Urithi wa mali za biashara unaweza kuathiri wajibu wa capital gains tax wa mrithi chini ya Income Tax Act Tanzania — inategemea thamani ya mali wakati wa urithi dhidi ya wakati wa uuzaji. Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa hesabu halisi ya wajibu wa kodi wa mrithi katika hali yako. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

question_sw: Kodi ya mapato ya mtu binafsi Tanzania ni sawa kwa raia na wasio raia — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Kwa ujumla, wakazi wa Tanzania (raia na wasio raia wanaoishi Tanzania zaidi ya siku 183 kwa mwaka) wanalipa kodi ya mapato kwa viwango sawa vya PAYE (bendi za kodi). Tofauti kuu ipo kwa usimamizi wa kodi ya zuio (WHT): wasio raia walioajiriwa wanalipa viwango tofauti vya WHT kwenye aina fulani za mapato (kama ada za mkurugenzi) ikilinganishwa na wakazi.
question_en: Tanzania individual income tax is the same for citizens and non-citizens — is this true?
answer_en: Generally, Tanzania residents (citizens and non-citizens living in Tanzania for more than 183 days per year) pay income tax at the same PAYE band rates. The main difference is in withholding tax treatment: employed non-residents pay different WHT rates on certain income types (such as director fees) compared to residents.

question_sw: Mwajiriwa wa mkataba wa miezi 3 anahitaji kusajiliwa NSSF — mkataba mfupi unasamehewa Tanzania?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mfanyakazi wa mkataba wa muda wowote (hata miezi 3) Tanzania anayepokea mshahara kutoka kwa mwajiri lazima asajiliwe NSSF na michango ilipwe kwa kipindi chote cha mkataba. Sheria ya NSSF HAINA msamaha wa muda wa mkataba mfupi. Mwajiri anayeajiri mfanyakazi kwa mkataba mfupi bila kusajili NSSF anakiuka sheria.
question_en: A worker on a 3-month contract needs to be registered with NSSF — is a short-term contract exempt in Tanzania?
answer_en: No. Any worker on any contract duration (even 3 months) in Tanzania who receives wages from an employer must be registered with NSSF and contributions paid for the entire contract period. The NSSF Act has NO short-term contract exemption. An employer who hires a worker on a short contract without NSSF registration is violating the law.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: NSSF inaweza kutoa mkopo wa dharura kwa mwanachama aliyechangia kwa miaka 3 Tanzania?
answer_sw: NSSF Tanzania imetoa programu za mkopo kwa wanachama wake katika mfumo wake wa umiliki. Masharti yanaweza kujumuisha: kipindi cha chini cha michango (angalau miezi 36 au zaidi), kuwa bado mwanachama wa sasa, na mkopo unaotolewa kwa matumizi maalum (nyumba, elimu). Angalia NSSF moja kwa moja kwa programu za mikopo ya hali ya sasa kwani masharti yanaweza kubadilika.
question_en: Can NSSF provide an emergency loan to a member who has contributed for 3 years in Tanzania?
answer_en: NSSF Tanzania has offered loan programmes to its members under its own ownership framework. Conditions may include: minimum contribution period (at least 36 months or more), still being a current member, and loans provided for specific uses (housing, education). Check NSSF directly for current loan programme terms as conditions can change.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

instruction: Je, kampuni yangu inaweza kuwa na tawi (branch) katika mji mwingine Tanzania?
output: Ndiyo. Kampuni iliyosajiliwa Tanzania inaweza kufungua matawi katika miji mingine bila kusajili kampuni mpya. Hata hivyo, matawi lazima yatajwe kwenye rekodi za BRELA na TRA. Kwa makampuni ya kigeni yanayofungua tawi Tanzania, kuna mchakato maalum wa usajilishaji wa kampuni ya kigeni (foreign branch) kupitia BRELA. Thibitisha mahitaji kamili na BRELA (brela.go.tz).

question_sw: Malipo ya mwisho ya kazi (gratuity/terminal benefits) yanastahili PAYE?
answer_sw: Malipo ya mwisho wa kazi kama vile malipo ya likizo yasiyotumika, mafao ya kujitenga (gratuity), na malipo ya fidia yanaweza kustahili PAYE kulingana na sheria ya kodi. Sehemu fulani inaweza kuwa huru — thibitisha hesabu halisi na TRA kabla ya kulipa.
question_en: Are terminal benefits and gratuity subject to PAYE?
answer_en: Terminal payments such as unused leave pay-out, gratuity, and severance may be subject to PAYE depending on the tax rules. Certain portions may be exempt — confirm the exact calculation with TRA before payment.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anayedai WCF lazima athibitishe nini?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi anayedai WCF lazima athibitishe: kwamba majeraha yalitokea wakati wa kufanya kazi, kwamba yalitokana na kazi au mazingira ya kazi, na kwamba waliripotiwa kwa mwajiri kwa wakati. Hati za matibabu na ripoti ya ajali kutoka kwa mwajiri zinahitajika kama ushahidi.
question_en: What must an employee claiming WCF prove?
answer_en: An employee claiming WCF must prove: that the injury occurred during the course of work, that it arose from work or the work environment, and that it was reported to the employer in time. Medical documentation and the employer's accident report are required as evidence.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Mgeni wa Tanzania anaweza kulipwa chini ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 605A inatumika kwa wafanyakazi wote wanaofanya kazi Tanzania Bara, bila kujali uraia. Mwajiri hawezi kulipa mfanyakazi mgeni mshahara chini ya kiwango cha GN 605A. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Can a foreign worker in Tanzania be paid below the GN 605A minimum wage?
answer_en: No. GN 605A applies to all workers employed in Tanzania Mainland, regardless of citizenship. An employer cannot pay a foreign employee below the GN 605A rate. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Asili ya bidhaa (originating status) na Common List — ni tofauti gani kwa STR?
answer_sw: Hii ni tofauti muhimu sana kwa STR: ORIGINATING STATUS inamaanisha bidhaa imezalishwa ndani ya nchi za EAC/COMESA — hii inahitajika. COMMON LIST inamaanisha aina ya bidhaa imo kwenye orodha ya ~370 zilizoidhinishwa — hii pia inahitajika. Hizi ni masharti MAWILI TOFAUTI. Bidhaa inayotoka EAC lakini haipo kwenye Common List HAIPATWI manufaa ya STR. Bidhaa ipo kwenye Common List lakini imezalishwa China HAIPATWI manufaa ya STR pia.
question_en: Originating status and the Common List — what is the difference for STR?
answer_en: This is a critical STR distinction: ORIGINATING STATUS means goods were produced within EAC/COMESA countries — this is required. COMMON LIST means the type of goods is among the ~370 approved items — this is also required. These are TWO SEPARATE conditions. Goods from EAC that are NOT on the Common List do NOT qualify for STR benefits. Goods that ARE on the Common List but produced in China also do NOT qualify for STR benefits.

instruction: EFD inafanya kazi bila umeme — kama umeme unakatika ninafanyaje?
output: EFD nyingi (hasa za kisasa) zina betri ya akiba au UPS inayoruhusu kufanya kazi kwa muda bila umeme. Hatua za kufuata wakati umeme unakatika: (1) Tumia betri ya EFD kama ipo — endelea kutoa risiti; (2) Kama EFD haifanyi kazi kabisa — andika rekodi za mikono ya kila muamala; (3) Unapopata umeme — ingiza rekodi za mikono kwenye EFD na unda risiti zilizokosekana (TRA ina mchakato wa 'recovery' transactions); (4) Toa habari TRA kama upotevu wa muda mrefu wa umeme ulikuzuia. Usiendelee na biashara bila rekodi yoyote. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na muuzaji wa EFD wako.

instruction: Ukipanga mishahara ya wafanyakazi wa sekta binafsi kulingana na GN 605A — ongezeko la asilimia ngapi unapaswa kupanga kwa wastani?
output: Upangaji sahihi unategemea sekta na sub-sector yako — wastani wa sekta zote ni asilimia 33.4, si 33.5. Wastani wa mshahara wa chini wa sekta binafsi ulipanda kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa mwezi chini ya GN 605A kuanzia 1 Januari 2026. Hata hivyo, ongezeko halisi linategemea sekta yako maalum na sub-sector — si ongezeko moja kwa wote. Bainisha sekta na sub-sector yako kwenye orodha ya GN 605A (sekta 16, sub-sectors 46) ili kupata kiwango chako sahihi. Thibitisha na PKF Eastern Africa au TanzLII.

instruction: Mwuzaji wa stendi ya soko — je, lazima atumie EFD?
output: Inategemea aina ya biashara na orodha ya TRA: EFD inahitajika kwa makundi maalum ya biashara yaliyobainishwa na TRA — vikundi vinavyojumuisha wauzaji wengi wa soko kama duka la rejareja, hoteli, migahawa, maduka ya nguo, maduka ya dawa, n.k. Mwuzaji mdogo wa stendi (machinga) ambaye si katika mfumo wa kodi ya kawaida anaweza kuwa amepewa muda wa mazoea. Hata hivyo, biashara inayokua na kufikia kizingiti cha VAT (TZS 200M/mwaka) au iliyosajiliwa VAT LAZIMA itumie EFD. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu hali yako maalum.

question_sw: EFD yangu imeharibika leo asubuhi. Je, ninafanya nini?
answer_sw: Ikiwa EFD imeharibika: (1) Taarifa TRA mara moja — ndani ya masaa 24 ya kugundua uharibika; (2) Tumia stakabadhi za mkono zilizochapishwa awali (pre-printed manual receipt book) kwa muda wa kusubiri EFD kurekebishwa; (3) Wasiliana na muuzaji wa EFD aliyeidhinishwa ili arekebishe au abadilishe EFD; (4) Rekodi muamala wote uliotokea kwa stakabadhi za mkono; (5) Baada ya EFD kurekebishwa, ingiza taarifa zilizokosekana inapobidi. Usiendelee kufanya biashara bila kurejesha risiti za kisheria.
question_en: My EFD broke down this morning. What do I do?
answer_en: If the EFD breaks down: (1) Notify TRA immediately — within 24 hours of discovering the fault; (2) Use pre-printed manual receipt books while waiting for the EFD to be repaired; (3) Contact the TRA-approved EFD supplier to repair or replace the EFD; (4) Record all transactions using manual receipts; (5) After EFD is repaired, enter any missing transaction data as required. Do not continue business without restoring legal receipt issuance.

question_sw: Cheti cha usafi wa kodi (tax clearance certificate) ni nini na ni lini ninahitajika?
answer_sw: Cheti cha usafi wa kodi ni hati inayotolewa na TRA inayothibitisha kwamba mlipa kodi hana deni la kodi wala madai yanayosubiri na TRA. Unahitajika wakati wa: kuomba mikataba ya Serikali (procurement / NeST tenders), kupata leseni fulani za biashara, kuomba mikopo kutoka benki fulani, kuhuisha leseni za biashara zilizosimamishwa, na kuomba vibali vya uagizaji (import permits) kwa bidhaa fulani. Kampuni au mtu binafsi inayohitaji cheti lazima iwe imetimiza wajibu wake wote wa kodi na haina madeni yanayosubiri.
answer_en: A tax clearance certificate is a document issued by TRA confirming that the taxpayer has no outstanding tax debts or pending claims with TRA. It is required when: applying for Government contracts (procurement/NeST tenders), obtaining certain business licences, applying for loans from some banks, renewing suspended business licences, and applying for import permits for certain goods. A company or individual applying for the certificate must have fulfilled all tax obligations and have no outstanding debts.
question_en: What is a tax clearance certificate and when do I need one?

instruction: Wateja wangu wa serikali wanahitaji invoice ya VAT — ninahitaji kusajili VAT hata kama sijafika kizingiti?
output: Ndio — usajili wa hiari wa VAT ni suluhisho lako. Wateja wa serikali na makampuni makubwa mara nyingi wanahitaji invoice ya VAT — bila usajili, huwezi kutoa invoice hiyo. Faida ya ziada: baada ya kusajili, unaweza kudai input VAT kwenye manunuzi yako ya biashara. Hata kama mauzo yako chini ya TZS 200M, usajili wa hiari ni busara kwa hali yako.

question_sw: Annual return ya kampuni inawasilishwa lini kwa BRELA?
answer_sw: Annual return ya kampuni inawasilishwa kwa BRELA ndani ya siku 42 baada ya mkutano wa mwaka (AGM) au ndani ya siku 30 baada ya tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya uanzishwaji kwa kampuni zisizofanya AGM. Kutowasillisha kwa wakati kunasababisha faini na hatimaye kufutwa kwa kampuni kwenye rejesta.
question_en: When is a company's annual return submitted to BRELA?
answer_en: A company annual return is submitted to BRELA within 42 days of the Annual General Meeting (AGM), or within 30 days of the incorporation anniversary date for companies that do not hold an AGM. Late filing results in penalties and eventually deregistration from the register.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Msimamizi wa kiwanda kidogo cha kusaga mahindi (posho mill) — ana wajibu gani?
answer_sw: Mmiliki wa posho mill anahitaji: (1) Leseni ya biashara kutoka halmashauri; (2) TIN kwa TRA; (3) Kama ana wafanyakazi waliohiriwa: PAYE, NSSF, WCF; (4) SDL kama wafanyakazi ≥10; (5) Usajili wa OSHA kama ana wafanyakazi na mashine ya hatari; (6) Kama mauzo yanafikia TZS 200M/mwaka: VAT. Kwa posho mill ndogo ya kawaida, PAYE na NSSF vinaweza visihitajike kama mmiliki anafanya kazi peke yake.
question_en: The owner of a small grain milling business (posho mill) — what obligations do they have?
answer_en: A posho mill owner needs: (1) A business licence from the local council; (2) A TIN with TRA; (3) If they have hired employees: PAYE, NSSF, WCF; (4) SDL if ≥10 employees; (5) OSHA registration if they have employees and dangerous machinery; (6) If sales reach TZS 200M/year: VAT. For a small typical posho mill, PAYE and NSSF may not apply if the owner works alone.

instruction: Ninaweza kulipa wafanyakazi wangu kwa crypto currency badala ya shilingi za Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kuhusu malipo ya mishahara kwa crypto currency. question_sw: Biashara ya mwaka mzima inayofunga kwa wiki moja tu — lazima itoe taarifa kwa TRA kwamba EFD haitafanya kazi?
answer_sw: Ikiwa biashara inafunga kwa muda mfupi (likizo, ukarabati wa jengo), EFD itakuwa haifanyi kazi kwa muda huo. Hii kwa kawaida si lazima kuripotiwa mapema kwa TRA ikiwa ni funga ya muda mfupi ya kawaida ya biashara. Hata hivyo, ikiwa EFD itakuwa imefungwa kwa muda mrefu, inashauriwa kuwasiliana na TRA ili kuzuia hali yoyote ya utata wa data au maswali ya ukaguzi.
question_en: A year-round business closing for just one week — must it notify TRA that the EFD won't operate?
answer_en: If a business closes briefly (holiday, building renovation), the EFD will be inactive for that period. This is generally not required to be pre-reported to TRA if it is an ordinary short business closure. However, if the EFD will be inactive for a long period, it is advisable to contact TRA to prevent any data anomaly or audit queries.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD inactive period guidance update

question_sw: WHT haihusiani na biashara ya kilimo — wakulima na washirika wa kilimo hawana WHT — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kwa ujumla. Hata sekta ya kilimo inaweza kukabili WHT kwenye malipo fulani kama royalties kwa mbegu au teknolojia, na ada za usimamizi. Hata hivyo, mkulima mdogo anayeuza mazao yake moja kwa moja kwa mnunuzi hana WHT inayostahili. WHT inategemea aina ya malipo, si sekta.
question_en: WHT has nothing to do with agriculture — farmers and agricultural cooperatives have no WHT — is this true?
answer_en: Not as a general rule. Even the agricultural sector can encounter WHT on certain payments such as royalties for seeds or technology, and management fees. However, a small farmer selling crops directly to a buyer has no WHT liability. WHT depends on the type of payment, not the sector.

question_sw: Je, kampuni mpya inahitaji usajili wa OSHA kabla ya kuanza kufanya kazi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni mpya yenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi inapaswa kusajiliwa na OSHA KABLA ya kuanza shughuli, au haraka iwezekanavyo baada ya kufikia wafanyakazi 10. Kuanza kufanya kazi bila usajili ni ukiukwaji wa sheria.
question_en: Does a new company need OSHA registration before starting operations?
answer_en: Yes. A new company with 10 or more employees should register with OSHA BEFORE commencing operations, or as soon as possible after reaching 10 employees. Operating without registration is a legal violation.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Muhtasari wa wajibu wa mwajiri wa Tanzania kwa OSHA, WCF, na NSSF — tofauti kuu ni zipi?
answer_sw: Muhtasari wa vyombo vitatu vya kazi Tanzania: NSSF — Pensheni na hifadhi ya jamii: mwajiri anasajili wafanyakazi, anakata 10% ya mfanyakazi, analipa 10% yake, anawasilisha jumla 20% ifikapo tarehe 10. WCF — Bima ya ajali za kazi: mwajiri anasajili biashara, analipa 0.5% ya mishahara ya mwaka, anapata bima ya fidia kwa wafanyakazi walioumia. OSHA — Usalama na afya mahali pa kazi: mwajiri mwenye 10+ wafanyakazi anasajili, anafanya tathmini ya hatari, anahakikisha mazingira salama, ana mkaguzi anayeweza kuja bila notisi.
question_en: Summary of a Tanzania employer's obligations to OSHA, WCF, and NSSF — what are the key differences?
answer_en: Summary of the three Tanzania labour bodies: NSSF — Pension and social security: employer registers workers, deducts 10% from employee, pays own 10%, remits total 20% by the 10th. WCF — Workplace accident insurance: employer registers the business, pays 0.5% of annual payroll, gets compensation insurance for injured workers. OSHA — Workplace safety and health: employer with 10+ workers registers, conducts risk assessment, ensures safe conditions, subject to inspectors who can arrive without notice.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania
next_review_trigger: OSHA, WCF, or NSSF Act amendment

instruction: Mkurugenzi wa kampuni analipwa ujira wa mkurugenzi (director's fee) — huhesabiwa katika SDL base?
output: Ujira wa mkurugenzi (director's fees) unaposwa chini ya SDL unategemea kama mkurugenzi ni mwajiriwa wa kampuni kwa wakati wote au mkurugenzi asiye mwajiriwa. MKURUGENZI MWAJIRIWA (full-time executive director): mshahara wake unaingia SDL base (kama wafanyakazi wengine). MKURUGENZI ASIYE MWAJIRIWA (non-executive director fees): kwa kawaida hukatwa WHT (Withholding Tax) ya 15% — si PAYE, na kwa hivyo haingi SDL base ya kawaida. Hata hivyo, ufafanuzi huu unategemea muundo wa mkataba. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na mshauri wa kodi kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: Mwajiri anatoa cheti gani kwa mfanyakazi wakati anamaliza kazi ili kuthibitisha PAYE iliyokatwa?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anatoa Hati ya Kuacha Kazi au sehemu husika ya Fomu P9 inayoonyesha jumla ya mapato na PAYE iliyokatwa hadi tarehe ya kumaliza kazi. Thibitisha hati halisi inayohitajika na TRA. Pia, ifikapo Machi 31 ya mwaka unaofuata, mwajiri anatoa Fomu P9 ikionyesha mapato ya mwaka mzima na PAYE yote iliyokatwa. Mfanyakazi anahifadhi fomu hizi kwa matumizi ya return ya kodi ya mtu binafsi.
answer_en: The employer issues a Leaving Certificate or relevant part of Form P9 showing total earnings and PAYE deducted up to the date of leaving. Confirm the exact document required with TRA. Also, by 31 March of the following year, the employer issues Form P9 showing full-year earnings and total PAYE deducted. The employee retains these forms for their individual tax return.
question_en: What certificate does an employer give an employee when they leave employment to confirm the PAYE deducted?
primary_source_name: TRA PAYE — P45 and P9 forms

question_sw: VAT credit na VAT refund — ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: VAT CREDIT (kubeba mbele): Badala ya kudai pesa moja kwa moja, VAT credit inabebwa mbele na kutumika kupunguza VAT ya mwezi unaofuata. VAT REFUND (pesa moja kwa moja): Omba TRA ikusanyie kiasi cha credit kwa pesa taslimu. Wengi hupendelea credit kwa sababu ni haraka zaidi — refund ya pesa inahitaji ukaguzi wa TRA ambao unachukua muda.
question_en: VAT credit and VAT refund — what is the difference?
answer_en: VAT CREDIT (carry forward): Instead of claiming cash directly, the VAT credit is carried forward and used to offset the following month's VAT. VAT REFUND (cash): Apply to TRA to receive the credit amount in cash. Many prefer the credit because it is faster — a cash refund requires a TRA audit which takes time.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

instruction: Ninapomuuzia mtu Bitcoin yangu — je, kuna VAT au kodi nyingine Tanzania?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Matibabu ya kodi kwa manunuzi na mauzo ya cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum, na kadhalika) Tanzania bado hayajapata mwongozo rasmi wazi kutoka TRA au BoT — hii iko nje ya wigo wangu wa mada. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants, ninashughulikia VAT ya biashara ya kawaida, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, na BRELA. Wasiliana na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz au mshauri wa kodi wa teknolojia ya kisasa.

question_sw: Wajibu wa mwajiri wa kulipa WCF unaanzia wafanyakazi wangapi?
answer_sw: Wajibu wa kulipa WCF unaanzia mfanyakazi WA KWANZA. Hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi kwa WCF — hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja tu analazimika kusajili na kulipa WCF. Hii inatofautiana na OSHA (threshold ya 10) na SDL (threshold ya 10).
question_en: From how many employees does the WCF payment obligation start?
answer_en: The WCF obligation starts from the FIRST employee. There is no employee count threshold for WCF — even an employer with just one employee must register and pay WCF. This differs from OSHA (threshold of 10) and SDL (threshold of 10).
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Tanzania ina VAT ya kawaida na VAT ndogo (reduced rate) kama nchi nyingine?
output: Hapana — Tanzania haina 'reduced rate' ya VAT. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Tofauti na nchi kama Kenya (0%, 8%, 16%) au Uingereza (0%, 5%, 20%), Tanzania ina 18% (standard), 16% (B2C digital tu, Sep 2025), na 0% (zero-rated — mauzo ya nje/exports; exempt ni hali tofauti: haziruhusu kudai input VAT). Hakuna reduced rate ya kati (kama 5% au 8%).

question_sw: WCF na OSHA zinahusiana vipi?
answer_sw: WCF na OSHA zinafanya kazi pamoja lakini kwa majukumu tofauti. OSHA inazuia ajali kwa kuhakikisha usalama kazini (inspections, improvement notices). WCF inalipa fidia baada ya ajali kutokea. Kwa ajali kubwa, mwajiri anaripoti kwa OSHA (masaa 24) na kwa WCF (siku saba za kazi). Kuzuia ajali kupitia OSHA kunasaidia kupunguza madai ya WCF.
question_en: How do WCF and OSHA relate to each other?
answer_en: WCF and OSHA work together but with different roles. OSHA PREVENTS accidents by ensuring workplace safety (inspections, improvement notices). WCF COMPENSATES after an accident occurs. For serious accidents the employer reports to OSHA (24 hours) and to WCF (7 working days). Preventing accidents through OSHA helps reduce WCF claims.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups
next_review_trigger: Workers Compensation Act or OSHA amendment

question_sw: Faini ya Mtanzania na faini ya mgeni ni sawa? Kusema kweli.
answer_sw: Hapana, si sawa. Mgeni anayekiuka GN 487A: faini ya angalau TZS 10,000,000 na hadi miezi 6 gerezani na kufutwa kwa visa. Mtanzania anayenusuru ukiukaji: faini ya TZS 5,000,000 AU miezi 3 gerezani. Adhabu ya mgeni ni kali zaidi.
question_en: Is the fine for a Tanzanian and a non-citizen the same? Honestly.
answer_en: No, they are not the same. Non-citizen violating GN 487A: minimum TZS 10,000,000 fine plus up to 6 months imprisonment plus visa revocation. Tanzanian facilitating a violation: TZS 5,000,000 fine OR 3 months imprisonment. The non-citizen's penalty is harsher.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Biashara inayoombwa na mteja wake wa biashara kutoa ankara ya VAT — lazima itoe EFD receipt pia au ankara ya VAT inatosha?
answer_sw: Biashara iliyolazimika kutumia EFD lazima itoe risiti ya EFD kwa kila muamala bila kujali ikiwa mteja anataka ankara ya VAT pia. Kwa wateja wa biashara (B2B) wanaodai input VAT, biashara inaweza kutoa ZOTE MBILI: risiti ya EFD NA ankara ya VAT inayoonyesha TIN za pande zote na maelezo ya bidhaa/huduma. Risiti ya EFD peke yake inaweza isiwe na maelezo ya kutosha kwa madai ya input VAT.
question_en: A business asked by its business customer for a VAT invoice — must it also issue an EFD receipt or is the VAT invoice enough?
answer_en: A business required to use an EFD must issue an EFD receipt for every transaction regardless of whether the customer also wants a VAT invoice. For business customers (B2B) claiming input VAT, the business can issue BOTH: an EFD receipt AND a VAT invoice showing both parties' TINs and goods/service details. An EFD receipt alone may not have sufficient detail for input VAT claims.
next_review_trigger: TRA EFD and VAT invoice dual-document update

question_sw: Ushuru wa stempu kwenye hati ya ushirika wa biashara (partnership deed) Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Hati ya ushirika wa biashara (partnership deed) ina ushuru wa stempu Tanzania. Kiasi kinategemea masharti ya Sheria ya Ushuru wa Stempu — kawaida ni kiasi kidogo cha kawaida (fixed amount) au asilimia ya mtaji wa ushirika. Angalia TRA kwa kiwango cha hali ya sasa. Hati ya ushirika isiyopigwa stempu inaweza kuathiri uhalali wa ushirika.
question_en: What is the stamp duty on a business partnership deed in Tanzania?
answer_en: A business partnership deed attracts stamp duty in Tanzania. The amount depends on the Stamp Duty Act provisions — typically a small fixed amount or a percentage of partnership capital. Check TRA for the current rate. An unstamped partnership deed can affect the legal validity of the partnership.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi (part-time) ana haki ya mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Ndiyo, kwa msingi wa pro-rata. Mfanyakazi wa muda mfupi ana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A kuhesabiwa kwa idadi ya masaa aliyofanya kazi ikilinganishwa na masaa ya kawaida ya wiki ya kazi. Thibitisha na MLYWF.
question_en: Does a part-time worker have the right to the minimum wage under GN 605A?
answer_en: Yes, on a pro-rata basis. A part-time worker is entitled to the GN 605A minimum wage calculated according to the hours worked compared to the normal working week. Confirm with MLYWF.

question_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kutoa choo cha kutosha na maji safi mahali pa kazi Tanzania — OSHA inasimamia hili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. OSHA Tanzania inasimamia vifaa vya msingi vya usafi na afya mahali pa kazi, ikiwa ni pamoja na: vyoo vya kutosha kwa idadi ya wafanyakazi, maji safi ya kunywa, nafasi ya kutosha ya kufanyia kazi, hewa safi, na taa ya kutosha. Hizi ni mahitaji ya msingi ya sheria ya OSHA — si 'ziada' zinazotegemea hiari ya mwajiri. Mkaguzi wa OSHA anaweza kutoa notisi ya kuboresha ikiwa mahitaji haya hayajakamilika.
question_en: Is an employer required to provide adequate toilets and clean water at the workplace in Tanzania — does OSHA regulate this?
answer_en: Yes. OSHA Tanzania regulates basic sanitation and health facilities at the workplace, including: adequate toilets for the number of workers, clean drinking water, sufficient workspace, fresh air, and adequate lighting. These are basic legal requirements under OSHA law — not extras that depend on employer discretion. An OSHA inspector can issue an improvement notice if these requirements are not met.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Muda mzima wa mchakato wa kupinga kodi kutoka tathmini hadi Mahakama ya Rufaa unaweza kuchukua muda gani?
answer_sw: Mchakato mzima unaweza kuchukua miaka mingi: pingamizi (miezi 6 ya Kamishna) + TRAB (miezi 6-12 ya kusikilizwa) + TRAT (miaka 1-2) + Mahakama ya Rufaa (miaka 2-5). Kwa jumla, kesi ngumu ya kodi inaweza kuchukua miaka 5-10 hadi kupata uamuzi wa mwisho. Makubaliano ya mapema ni ya busara mara nyingi.
question_en: How long can the full tax dispute process from assessment to Court of Appeal take?
answer_en: The full process can take many years: objection (Commissioner's 6 months) + TRAB (6-12 months of hearings) + TRAT (1-2 years) + Court of Appeal (2-5 years). Overall, a complex tax case can take 5-10 years to reach a final decision. Early settlement is often prudent.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wa mkataba wa muda mfupi (casual workers) wanahesabiwaje kwa SDL?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Wafanyakazi wa muda mfupi wanaopewa mishahara: mishahara yao inajumuishwa katika hesabu ya SDL kama wengine. Kama wafanyakazi wako wote (wa kudumu + wa muda mfupi) wanafikia 10+, SDL inahitajika. Thibitisha ufafanuzi wa 'mfanyakazi' na TRA kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: Kijiji chetu kina mtu kutoka Kenya anayeendesha wakala wa pesa za simu — je, hii ni halali?
answer_sw: Hapana, si halali chini ya GN 487A (2025). Raia wa Kenya au nchi nyingine yoyote ambaye si raia wa Tanzania hawezi kuendesha biashara ya wakala wa pesa za simu (mobile money agent) nchini Tanzania. Hii ni moja ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa rasmi. Adhabu kwa mtu huyu ni faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 na kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, pamoja na kufutwa kwa viza yake. Raia wa Tanzania yeyote aliyemwezesha (kama kusimamia au kushiriki) anaweza kupata faini ya TZS milioni 5 au kifungo cha miezi 3. Ni vyema kuwasiliana na Idara ya Uhamiaji au polisi wa biashara.
question_en: Our village has a person from Kenya running a mobile money agent — is this legal?
answer_en: No, it is not legal under GN 487A (2025). A Kenyan national or any non-Tanzanian citizen cannot operate a mobile money agent business in Tanzania. This is one of the 15 officially prohibited activities. Penalties for that person are a minimum TZS 10 million fine and up to 6 months imprisonment, plus visa revocation. Any Tanzanian citizen who facilitated (such as supervising or partnering) faces a TZS 5 million fine or 3 months imprisonment. It is advisable to contact the Immigration Department or business police.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: New Business Licensing Act or amendment to GN 487A

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa probation alitolewa kazi mwezi wa 3. Je, NSSF iliyolipwa inarejeshwa?
answer_sw: Hapana — NSSF iliyolipwa hairejiswi kwa mwajiri wala mfanyakazi wakati ajira inaisha kabla ya muda. Michango iliyolipwa inabaki kwenye akaunti ya NSSF ya mfanyakazi. Mfanyakazi anaweza kupata faida za muda mfupi (short-term benefits) au kuhifadhi michango hiyo kwa ajira yake ijayo. Mwajiri hawezi kudai kurejeshwa kwa michango ya mwajiri aliyolipa.
question_en: A probationary employee was terminated in month 3. Is NSSF paid refunded?
answer_en: No — paid NSSF is not refunded to either the employer or employee when employment ends before completion. Contributions paid remain in the employee's NSSF account. The employee may access short-term benefits or retain those contributions for future employment. The employer cannot claim a refund of employer contributions already paid.

instruction: NSSF, WCF, na SDL — tofauti yao ni nini kwa kifupi?
output:
NSSF (National Social Security Fund): 10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi | wafanyakazi wote | nssf.go.tz. Kusudi: pensheni na usalama wa jamii. 
WCF (Workers' Compensation Fund): 0.5% mwajiri | waajiri WOTE (hata mfanyakazi 1) | portal.wcf.go.tz. Kusudi: fidia ya ajali za kazi.

instruction: SDL na PAYE zinawasilishwa TRA tarehe gani kila mwezi?
output: SDL na PAYE zote mbili zinawasilishwa TRA ifikapo tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Wanawasilishwa kwenye fomu tofauti kupitia mfumo wa ITAX/IDRAS wa TRA, lakini deadline ni moja -- tarehe 7. Hii ni tofauti na NSSF ambayo ina deadline yake tofauti. Thibitisha tarehe za sasa na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: Je, mtu wa kigeni anaweza kuomba ruhusa maalum ya kufanya biashara iliyokatazwa na GN 487A?

Hakuna dalili kwamba ruhusa maalum inaweza kutolewa kwa biashara kama rejareja, ukarabati wa simu, au saluni. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji na wakili wa biashara kwa habari za kisasa.

question_sw: Mwajiri anahitaji usajili wa BRELA kabla ya kuomba TIN ya TRA — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si lazima kwa kila hali. Mtu binafsi (individual) anaweza kupata TIN bila kusajili kampuni na BRELA. Hata hivyo, kampuni au biashara iliyoundwa inapaswa kusajiliwa BRELA kwanza ili kupata TIN ya kampuni. TRA inahitaji ushahidi wa uwepo wa kisheria wa biashara (kama Cheti cha Uanzishwaji au usajili wa jina la biashara).
question_en: Is BRELA registration required before applying for a TRA TIN — is this true?
answer_en: Not for every case. An individual can obtain a personal TIN without BRELA registration. However, an incorporated company or registered business should be registered with BRELA first to get a company TIN. TRA requires evidence of the business's legal existence (such as Certificate of Incorporation or business name registration).
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Je, biashara ya rejareja yoyote imekatazwa, au ni aina fulani tu?
answer_sw: GN 487A inakataza biashara ya jumla (wholesale) NA rejareja (retail) kwa ujumla kwa raia wa kigeni. Hii inajumuisha maduka ya bidhaa, supermarket ndogo, na uuzaji wa moja kwa moja kwa wateja wa Tanzania. Hakuna msamaha kwa aina ndogo ya rejareja au eneo maalum la biashara.
question_en: Is any retail business prohibited, or only specific types?
answer_en: GN 487A prohibits wholesale AND retail trade in general for non-citizens. This includes goods shops, small supermarkets, and direct sales to Tanzanian consumers. There is no exemption for small-scale retail or a specific business location.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

instruction: OSHA inashughulikia pia sekta ya kilimo au ni viwanda tu?
output: OSHA inashughulikia MAHALI POTE PA KAZI Tanzania Bara — ikiwa ni pamoja na sekta ya kilimo, viwanda, ofisi, maduka, hospitali, na kadhalika. Hakuna sekta iliyosamehewa na OSHA moja kwa moja. Hata shamba la kilimo lenye wafanyakazi wa kulipwa lina wajibu wa msingi wa OSHA. Hata hivyo, mahitaji yanaweza kutofautiana kulingana na sekta na hatari yake: Sekta za hatari zaidi (ujenzi, migodi, kemikali) zina mahitaji ya ziada. Sekta za hatari ndogo (ofisi) zina mahitaji ya msingi. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz kwa mahitaji maalum ya sekta yako.

question_sw: Je, hakuna kiwango cha chini cha NSSF kwa mfanyakazi wa nusu muda?
answer_sw: Hakuna kiwango cha chini cha shilingi za mchango wa NSSF kilichotajwa kisheria — mchango ni asilimia 20% ya mshahara mkubwa wa jumla, bila kujali kiasi. Mfanyakazi anayepata mshahara wa chini ya kiwango cha chini cha mshahara cha sekta yake bado analipa NSSF kwa msingi wa mshahara anaolipwa halisi. Kiwango cha chini cha mshahara (GN 605A) kinaathiri kiwango cha chini cha mshahara unaolipwa, si hesabu ya NSSF.
question_en: Is there no minimum NSSF amount for a part-time worker?
answer_en: There is no legally specified minimum shilling amount for NSSF contributions — the contribution is 20% of actual gross wages, regardless of the amount. An employee earning below their sector's minimum wage still pays NSSF based on actual wages paid. The minimum wage (GN 605A) affects the minimum wage that must be paid, not the NSSF calculation itself.

question_sw: Kizingiti cha VAT cha miezi 6 ni TZS ngapi — ni sawa na kizingiti cha miezi 12?
answer_sw: Hapana — viwango ni tofauti. Kizingiti cha miezi 12: TZS 200,000,000 (milioni 200). Kizingiti cha miezi 6: TZS 100,000,000 (milioni 100) tu. Si kizingiti kimoja cha TZS 200M kinachotumika kwa njia zote mbili. Kizingiti cha miezi 6 ni nusu ya cha miezi 12. Kila kimoja kinafanya kazi kwa njia yake: ukizidi MOJA tu kati ya viwango hivi viwili, usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima mara moja.
question_en: What is the 6-month VAT threshold — is it the same as the 12-month threshold?
answer_en: No — the thresholds are different. 12-month threshold: TZS 200,000,000 (200 million). 6-month threshold: TZS 100,000,000 (100 million) only. It is not one threshold of TZS 200M applied in both ways. The 6-month threshold is half of the 12-month one. Each works independently: if you exceed EITHER ONE of these two thresholds, VAT registration is immediately mandatory.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing VAT registration thresholds

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania ana haki ya WCF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wa kigeni wanaofanya kazi Tanzania chini ya mkataba wa ajira wa Tanzania wana haki ya WCF kwa majeraha yanayotokana na kazi. Mwajiri anayemwajiri mfanyakazi wa kigeni Tanzania analazimika kumjumuisha katika orodha ya WCF.
question_en: Does a foreign worker employed in Tanzania have WCF rights?
answer_en: Yes. Foreign workers employed in Tanzania under a Tanzania employment contract are entitled to WCF for work-related injuries. An employer engaging a foreign worker in Tanzania must include them in the WCF payroll.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Ununuzi wa mafuta ya dizeli kwa matumizi ya biashara — input VAT inaweza kudaiwa?
answer_sw: Kwa biashara zilizoposajiliwa VAT zinazotumia mafuta kwa biashara (kwa magari ya biashara, mashine) — input VAT ya mafuta inaweza kudaiwa. Hata hivyo, kama mafuta yanatumika kwa gari la kibinafsi la msimamizi, input VAT haiwezi kudaiwa. Thibitisha matumizi ya mafuta na uhifadhi kumbukumbu nzuri.
question_en: Purchases of diesel fuel for business use — can input VAT be claimed?
answer_en: For VAT-registered businesses using fuel for business purposes (business vehicles, machinery) — input VAT on fuel can be claimed. However, if fuel is used for a personal executive vehicle, input VAT cannot be claimed. Verify fuel usage and maintain good records.

question_sw: Adhabu kwa raia wa kigeni anayeendesha biashara iliyopigwa marufuku chini ya GN 487A ni nini?
answer_sw: Adhabu kwa raia wa kigeni anayekiuka GN 487A ni kali: 1) Faini ya chini ya TZS milioni 10 (kumi). 2) Kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 (sita) gerezani. 3) Kufutwa kwa visa na kupigwa marufuku kuingia Tanzania tena. Hizi ni adhabu za chini (minimum) — mahakama inaweza kutoa adhabu kubwa zaidi. Shirika la Uhamiaji lilifanya zoezi maalum la ukaguzi kati ya 11 Septemba na 8 Oktoba 2025. Thibitisha na wakili wa uhamiaji mara moja.
question_en: What are the penalties for a non-citizen running a prohibited business under GN 487A?
answer_en: Penalties for a non-citizen violating GN 487A are severe: 1) Minimum TZS 10 million fine. 2) Up to 6 months imprisonment. 3) Visa revocation and prohibition from re-entering Tanzania. These are minimum penalties — a court may impose heavier punishment. The Immigration Services Department ran a specific compliance exercise from 11 September to 8 October 2025. Consult an immigration lawyer immediately.

question_sw: Ukaguzi wa TRA (tax audit) unafanywa mara ngapi kwa biashara ndogo Tanzania?
answer_sw: TRA inafanya ukaguzi wa kodi kulingana na tathmini ya hatari (risk-based auditing). Biashara ndogo iliyofuata vizuri sheria za kodi inaweza isikaguliwe kwa miaka mingi. Ukaguzi unaweza kusababishwa na: tofauti kubwa kati ya mapato yaliyoripotiwa na mauzo ya benki, malalamiko ya watu wengine, sekta zenye hatari ya juu, au uteuzi wa nasibu. Huhifadhi rekodi nzuri za miaka 5+ kwa ajili ya ukaguzi wowote.
question_en: How often does TRA conduct a tax audit on a small business in Tanzania?
answer_en: TRA conducts tax audits based on risk assessment (risk-based auditing). A small business that has complied well with tax laws may not be audited for many years. An audit can be triggered by: large discrepancy between reported income and bank deposits, complaints from others, high-risk sectors, or random selection. Keep good records for 5+ years in case of any audit.

question_sw: Ni wakati gani ni bora kudai refund ya pesa badala ya kubeba VAT credit mbele?
answer_sw: Kubeba VAT credit mbele ni bora kama unatarajia kuwa na output VAT ya kutosha mwezi unaofuata — credit itafidia pasi na muda. Kudai refund ya pesa ni bora kama: una mkopo wa credit mkubwa sana unaokua, au biashara yako ina mtiririko wa fedha (cash flow) mbaya na unahitaji pesa. Refund ya pesa inachukua muda zaidi kwa sababu TRA lazima ikague.
question_en: When is it better to claim a cash refund versus carrying the VAT credit forward?
answer_en: Carrying the credit forward is better when you expect sufficient output VAT the following month — the credit will offset it quickly. Claiming a cash refund is better when: you have a very large growing credit balance, or your business has poor cash flow and you need the money. Cash refunds take longer because TRA must audit first.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment or TRA VAT refund procedure update

question_sw: Biashara yangu haijasajiliwa VAT — lakini ninaweka VAT ya 18% kwenye invoice zangu kwa sababu wateja wanauliza. Je, hii inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: HAPANA — hii ni kinyume kabisa cha sheria. Ni biashara zilizosajiliwa VAT TU ambazo zinaruhusiwa kukusanya VAT na kuitoa kwenye invoice. Biashara isiyosajiliwa VAT inayoweka VAT kwenye invoice inafanya vitendo viwili visivyo halali: (1) inakusanya pesa ambazo si yake kisheria na si zake kwa wateja; (2) inaweza kutoa 'input VAT credit ya uwongo' kwa wateja wanaotaka kudai mkopo. TRA inaweza kushtaki biashara kama hiyo na kutoza adhabu kali.
question_en: My business is not VAT registered — but I put 18% VAT on my invoices because clients ask for it. Is this permitted?
answer_en: NO — this is completely against the law. Only VAT-REGISTERED businesses are permitted to charge VAT and show it on invoices. An unregistered business putting VAT on invoices commits two unlawful acts: (1) it is collecting money it is not legally entitled to from clients; (2) it may be issuing 'false input VAT credits' to clients who want to claim credits. TRA may prosecute such a business and impose severe penalties.

question_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa royalties kwa wakazi wa Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha withholding tax kwa royalties kwa WAKAZI wa Tanzania ni asilimia 15. Kwa WASIO WAKAZI, kiwango pia ni asilimia 15. Kiwango hiki kinatumika kwa malipo ya haki ya matumizi ya mali ya kiakili, mauzo ya teknolojia, na malipo yanayofanana.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on royalties for Tanzania residents?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on royalties for Tanzania RESIDENTS is 15%. For NON-RESIDENTS the rate is also 15%. This rate applies to payments for use of intellectual property rights, technology transfers, and similar payments.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi ana NSSF na pia kampuni inalipa kwenye mfuko wa pensheni wa binafsi. Je, hii inaruhusiwa?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kampuni inaweza kulipa NSSF ya lazima (mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10%) NA pia kuchangia kwenye mfuko wa pensheni wa ziada (supplementary pension scheme) kwa faida za mfanyakazi. Hii ni kawaida kwa kampuni kubwa zinazotoa faida za ziada. Mchango wa ziada wa pensheni una athari za kodi (PAYE) kulingana na jinsi unavyoshughulikiwa. Wasiliana na TRA/mshauri wa kodi kwa athari za kodi za mchango wa pensheni ya ziada.
question_en: An employee has NSSF and the company also pays into a private pension fund. Is this allowed?
answer_en: Yes. A company can pay mandatory NSSF (employer 10% + employee 10%) AND also contribute to a supplementary pension scheme as an employee benefit. This is common for large companies offering additional benefits. Supplementary pension contributions have tax implications (PAYE) depending on how they are treated. Contact TRA/a tax adviser for the tax treatment of supplementary pension contributions.

question_sw: Nini lengo la SDL — ni malipo ya likizo ya ugonjwa au mafunzo ya kazi?
answer_sw: Lengo la SDL ni kufadhili mafunzo ya ufundi na ujuzi wa kazi (vocational training) nchini Tanzania — si malipo ya likizo. SDL ilanzishwa ili kusaidia VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) na mifumo ya mafunzo ya kitaalamu. Mwajiri ndiye analipa, mfanyakazi hapunguziwa kitu.
question_en: What is the purpose of SDL — is it sick leave payments or job training?
answer_en: The purpose of SDL is to fund vocational and job skills training in Tanzania — not leave payments. SDL was established to support VETA (Vocational Education and Training Authority) and professional training systems. The employer pays it; nothing is deducted from the employee.
next_review_trigger: Finance Act amendment changing SDL rate or threshold

question_sw: Mgeni alikuwa na duka tangu 2020 — biashara yake ya zamani inalindwa dhidi ya GN 487A?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A ya 2025 inatumika kwa biashara zote — za zamani NA mpya. Hakuna msamaha kwa biashara zilizoanzishwa kabla ya tarehe ya kuanza (28 Julai 2025). Mgeni aliyekuwa na duka la rejareja kabla ya tarehe hiyo bado lazima atii GN 487A — ama ahamishie kwa raia wa Tanzania au akabiliane na adhabu.
question_en: A non-citizen had a shop since 2020 — is their existing business protected from GN 487A?
answer_en: No. GN 487A of 2025 applies to all businesses — existing AND new. There is no exemption for businesses established before the effective date (28 July 2025). A non-citizen who had a retail shop before that date must still comply with GN 487A — either transfer it to a Tanzanian citizen or face penalties.
primary_source_name: Government Notice 487A - Business Licensing Prohibition Order 2025, TanzLII
next_review_trigger: GN 487A amendment, court ruling, or ministry clarification

question_sw: Mfanyakazi anapata overtime ya TZS 200,000 na bonus ya TZS 300,000 mwezi huu. Je, vinatozwa PAYE?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Overtime na bonus zote zinaongezwa kwenye mshahara wa kawaida wa mwezi huo kabla ya kuhesabu PAYE. Kwa mfano, mshahara wa msingi wa TZS 500,000 + overtime TZS 200,000 + bonus TZS 300,000 = mapato ya mwezi TZS 1,000,000. PAYE inakokotolewa kwenye TZS 1,000,000 kulingana na jedwali la PAYE. Hakuna msamaha maalum wa overtime au bonus Tanzania.
answer_en: Yes. Overtime and bonuses are both added to the regular monthly salary before calculating PAYE. For example: basic salary TZS 500,000 + overtime TZS 200,000 + bonus TZS 300,000 = monthly income TZS 1,000,000. PAYE is calculated on TZS 1,000,000 according to the PAYE tax bands. There is no special exemption for overtime or bonuses in Tanzania.
question_en: An employee receives overtime of TZS 200,000 and a bonus of TZS 300,000 this month. Are they subject to PAYE?

question_sw: Biashara yangu ina wafanyakazi 20 na jumla ya mishahara ni TZS 12,000,000 kwa mwezi. Niambie: SDL, NSSF ya mwajiri, na SDL vinajumlika vingapi?
answer_sw: Hesabu: SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) = TZS 12,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 420,000. NSSF ya mwajiri = TZS 12,000,000 × 10% = TZS 1,200,000. Jumla ya malipo ya mwajiri kwa TRA na NSSF = TZS 1,620,000. (SDL na PAYE kwenda TRA; NSSF kwenda NSSF.) SDL inalipwa siku ya 7 pamoja na PAYE.
question_en: My business has 20 employees with total payroll TZS 12,000,000 per month. Calculate: SDL, employer NSSF, and their combined total.
answer_en: Calculation: SDL (Skills Development Levy — Kodi ya Kukuza Ujuzi) = TZS 12,000,000 × 3.5% = TZS 420,000. Employer NSSF = TZS 12,000,000 × 10% = TZS 1,200,000. Total employer obligations to TRA and NSSF = TZS 1,620,000. (SDL and PAYE go to TRA; NSSF goes to NSSF.) SDL is due on the 7th together with PAYE.

instruction: Amri ya mshahara wa 2022 ilifutwa rasmi — lini?
output: Ndiyo, Amri ya Mshahara wa Chini ya Sekta Binafsi ya mwaka 2022 ilifutwa rasmi na GN605A kuanzia tarehe 31 Desemba 2025. Tangu Januari 1, 2026, amri hiyo ya 2022 haina nguvu yoyote ya kisheria. Mwajiri yeyote anayeendelea kutumia viwango vya 2022 baada ya Januari 2026 anakiuka sheria. Viwango vilivyopo sasa ni vile vya GN605A peke yake.

question_sw: Mgeni aliyeomba vibali lakini bado anasubiri jibu — anaweza kuanza kufanya kazi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kuwasilisha ombi la kibali cha kazi HAKUTOI ruhusa ya kufanya kazi wakati wa kusubiri jibu. Mfanyakazi wa kigeni lazima APOKEE kibali halisi kilichotolewa kabla ya kuanza kufanya kazi. Kufanya kazi wakati ombi linaendelea ni ukiukwaji wa sheria ya uhamiaji.
question_en: A foreigner who has applied for a permit but is still awaiting a decision — can they start working?
answer_en: No. Submitting a work permit application does NOT grant permission to work while awaiting the decision. A foreign worker must RECEIVE the actual issued permit before commencing employment. Working while an application is pending is a violation of immigration law.

question_sw: NSSF Tanzania inashughulikia bima ya afya (health insurance) — NSSF italipa gharama za hospitali za mwajiriwa — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Si sahihi kabisa. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) Tanzania ni mfuko wa pensheni na manufaa ya kijamii — si bima ya afya ya kila siku. NSSF inalipa: pensheni ya uzee (miaka 60/55), manufaa ya ulemavu, manufaa ya kifo cha mapema. Kwa bima ya afya ya hospitali, Tanzania ina mfumo tofauti — NHIF (National Health Insurance Fund) au CHF (Community Health Fund). NSSF na NHIF ni mifumo tofauti ya bima ya kijamii.
question_en: NSSF Tanzania covers health insurance — NSSF will pay an employee's hospital bills — is this correct?
answer_en: Not quite. NSSF (National Social Security Fund) Tanzania is a pension and social benefits fund — not everyday health insurance. NSSF pays: old-age pension (age 60/55), disability benefits, early death benefits. For hospital health insurance, Tanzania has a separate system — NHIF (National Health Insurance Fund) or CHF (Community Health Fund). NSSF and NHIF are different social insurance systems.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

question_sw: Tofauti kati ya ushuru wa stempu na kodi ya ardhi (land rent) Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa stempu na kodi ya ardhi ni mambo mawili tofauti kabisa. Ushuru wa stempu ni kodi ya mara moja inayolipwa kwenye hati za kisheria kama uhamishaji wa ardhi — inalipwa na mnunuzi mara moja. Kodi ya ardhi (ground rent/land rent) ni malipo ya kila mwaka kwa Serikali kwa matumizi ya ardhi ya umma (hekta/ekari) — inalipwa mwaka hadi mwaka na mmiliki au mpangishaji.
question_en: What is the difference between stamp duty and land rent in Tanzania?
answer_en: Stamp duty and land rent are two completely separate things. Stamp duty is a one-time tax paid on legal instruments like land transfer — paid once by the buyer. Land rent is an annual payment to the Government for use of public land — paid year after year by the owner or leaseholder.

instruction: EFD — ni tofauti gani kati ya ECR na POS system?
output: ECR (Electronic Cash Register) na POS (Point of Sale) ni aina mbili tofauti za EFD zilizoidhinishwa na TRA: ECR: kifaa kimoja kilichojitegemea cha kurekodi mauzo na kutoa risiti — rahisi na nafuu, kinafaa kwa biashara ndogo za rejareja. POS System: mfumo mkubwa zaidi unaounganisha kompyuta/tablet na printer — unaweza kushughulikia hesabu ngumu zaidi, akaunti za wateja, inventory. Vyote viwili lazima viwe: (1) Vimeidhinishwa na TRA; (2) Vimesajiliwa kwa TRA kabla ya kutumika; (3) Vimeunganishwa na TIMS (kwa biashara zinazohitajika). Chaguo linategemea ukubwa na aina ya biashara. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: WCF inatumika kwa sekta ya kilimo — wakulima wanaolima shamba lao wenyewe wana haki?
answer_sw: WCF inahusu WAAJIRI NA WAFANYAKAZI — yaani watu wanaofanya kazi kwa mtu mwingine. Mkulima anayemiliki na kulima shamba lake mwenyewe (self-employed) hana wajibu wa WCF na hana haki za WCF kama mfanyakazi. Hata hivyo, mkulima anayeajiri wafanyakazi wa kulima shamba lake analazimika kulipa WCF kwa wafanyakazi hao.
question_en: Does WCF apply to agriculture — do farmers working their own land have rights?
answer_en: WCF relates to EMPLOYERS AND EMPLOYEES — people working for someone else. A farmer who owns and works their own land (self-employed) has no WCF obligation and no WCF rights as a worker. However, a farmer who employs workers on their land must pay WCF contributions for those workers.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Chakula cha msingi kina VAT ya asilimia 5 Tanzania?
output: Hapana. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Chakula cha msingi (kama nafaka, unga, sukari) kinaweza kuwa zero-rated (0% VAT — unaweza kudai input VAT) au exempt (huna wajibu wa VAT lakini pia huwezi kudai input VAT) — si 5%. Hizi ni hali tofauti kisheria — thibitisha hali ya bidhaa yako maalum na orodha rasmi ya TRA (tra.go.tz). Thibitisha orodha sahihi ya bidhaa zilizosamehewa VAT na TRA (tra.go.tz).

instruction: TIMS ni nini na inahusiana vipi na EFD yangu?
output: TIMS (Tanzania Integrated Management System) ni mfumo wa TRA unaounganisha EFD zote Tanzania kwa wakati halisi. Kila risiti unayopiga kwenye EFD yako inatumwa moja kwa moja kwa TRA kupitia TIMS — inatosha TRA kuona mauzo yako wakati huo huo. Faida kwako: ikiwa EFD itaharibika, rekodi za TIMS zinaendelea. Hatari: kukwepa risiti kunaonekana mara moja kwenye TIMS.

instruction: Mwajiri wangu analipa chini ya kiwango cha GN605A. Naweza mfanyabiashara wangu nini kisheria?
output: Ndiyo, una haki. Mwajiri anapaswa kulipa angalau kiwango cha chini cha sekta yako kulingana na GN605A tangu Januari 2026. Hatua unazoweza chukua: (1) toa malalamiko kwa Ofisi ya Kazi ya wilaya yako (Ministry of Labour); (2) omba malipo yaliyobaki (backpay) tangu Januari 2026; (3) unaweza pia kuomba msaada wa Bodi ya Usuluhishi wa Migogoro ya Kazi (CMA). Haki yako inalindwa kisheria.

question_sw: Kampuni inaweza kukatia mwajiriwa wake kodi ya PAYE na haitoi risiti — mwajiriwa hana haki ya kudai ushahidi wa makato — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana kabisa. Mwajiriwa ana haki ya kupokea ushahidi wa makato ya PAYE — kawaida kwa njia ya slip ya mshahara (payslip) au nyaraka za mwisho wa mwaka. Mwajiriwa anaweza kutumia kumbukumbu hizi kuthibitisha malipo ya kodi yake na kudai marejesho (tax refund) ikiwa atalipishwa kodi zaidi ya kiasi kinachohitajika. Kushindwa kutoa ushahidi wa makato ni ukiukwaji wa wajibu wa mwajiri.
question_en: A company can deduct PAYE from an employee and give no receipt — the employee has no right to claim evidence of deductions — is this true?
answer_en: Absolutely not. An employee has the right to receive evidence of PAYE deductions — normally via a payslip or end-of-year documents. The employee can use these records to prove their tax payments and claim a refund if overtaxed. Failing to provide deduction evidence is a breach of employer obligations.

question_sw: Biashara ya Tanzania inayofilisiwa (insolvent) ina utaratibu gani wa kufuta na wadai wanafanyaje?
answer_sw: Ufilisi (insolvency/liquidation) wa kampuni Tanzania unafuata Sheria ya Makampuni. Kuna: (1) ufilisi wa hiari (voluntary liquidation) ukiamuliwa na wanaohisa, (2) ufilisi wa kulazimishwa (compulsory liquidation) ukiamriwa na mahakama kwa ombi la mdai. Msimamizi wa mali (liquidator) anachaguliwa, anauza mali, analipa wadai kwa mpangilio wa kipaumbele cha kisheria, na hatimaye kampuni inafutwa. TRA ni mmoja wa wadai wa kipaumbele cha juu.
question_en: What is the procedure for a Tanzania business going insolvent and what do creditors do?
answer_en: Corporate insolvency/liquidation in Tanzania follows the Companies Act. There is: (1) voluntary liquidation decided by shareholders, (2) compulsory liquidation ordered by court on creditor application. A liquidator is appointed, sells assets, pays creditors in the legally prescribed priority order, and the company is finally struck off. TRA is one of the high-priority creditors.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

instruction: GN 605A imeinua mshahara wa chini — je, SDL yangu itaongezeka pia?
output: Ndiyo — kama ulisaidia wafanyakazi wako kufikia viwango vipya vya mshahara wa chini vya GN 605A (vilivyoanza 1 Januari 2026), jumla ya mishahara yako itaongezeka — na SDL pia itaongezeka kwa asilimia sawa (3.5%). Mfano: kama jumla ya mishahara ilikuwa TZS 4,000,000/mwezi kabla, SDL ilikuwa TZS 140,000. Baada ya ongezeko la GN 605A, kama mishahara inaenda TZS 5,000,000 — SDL mpya = TZS 175,000. Hii ni athari ya moja kwa moja ya GN 605A kwa SDL. Pia NSSF itaongezeka (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi wa mishahara mipya). Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na GN 605A.

question_sw: Ninafanya biashara ya usafi — wafanyakazi 15. Je, ninalipa SDL?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. SDL (Skills Development Levy) inatakiwa kwa waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi. Una wafanyakazi 15, kwa hivyo unalipa SDL. Kiwango ni asilimia 3.5 ya jumla ya mshahara wote wa wafanyakazi wako. Inalipwa TRA pamoja na PAYE kila mwezi ifikapo tarehe 7.
question_en: I run a cleaning business — 15 employees. Do I pay SDL?
answer_en: Yes. SDL (Skills Development Levy) is required for employers with 10 or more employees. You have 15 staff, so you pay SDL. The rate is 3.5% of total wages paid to all employees. It is paid to TRA together with PAYE every month by the 7th.

instruction: Mwajiri ana wafanyakazi 9 na anaajiri wa 10 wiki hii -- SDL inaanza kutumika lini?
output: SDL inaanza kutumika mara tu idadi ya wafanyakazi ikiwa 10 au zaidi. Mara unapoajiri mfanyakazi wa 10 -- haijalishi katikati ya mwezi au mwishoni -- SDL inatakiwa kulipwa kwa mwezi huo huo. Kizingiti ni wafanyakazi 10, si zaidi ya 10. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Biashara ya kilimo kubwa — GN 487A inazuia mgeni kulima kwa faida?
answer_sw: Kilimo kwa ujumla hakiko kwenye orodha ya shughuli 15 zilizokatazwa na GN 487A. Hata hivyo, uuzaji wa rejareja wa mazao unaweza kuathiriwa ikiwa unachukuliwa kama biashara ya rejareja. Kwa uwekezaji mkubwa wa kilimo, makubaliano na TIC yanaweza kuhitajika. Thibitisha na mwanasheria.
question_en: Large-scale agriculture — does GN 487A prevent a non-citizen from farming commercially?
answer_en: Agriculture in general is not on the list of 15 prohibited activities under GN 487A. However, retail sale of farm produce could be affected if treated as retail trade. For large agricultural investments, agreements with TIC may be required. Verify with a lawyer.

instruction: Wafanyakazi wangu wanauliza kuhusu nyongeza ya mshahara wa Januari 2026. Niwaelezeeje?
output: Elezea hivi: GN605A ilianza kutumika Januari 1, 2026, ikiwa na viwango vipya vya mshahara wa chini kwa sekta zote 16. Viwango vipya vina ongezeko la wastani wa asilimia 33.4 — kutoka TZS 275,060 hadi TZS 358,322 kwa wastani wa taifa. Hata hivyo, kiwango halisi kinategemea sekta na subsekta yako. Angalia GN605A kwa kiwango cha sekta yako maalum, au thibitisha na Ofisi ya Kazi.

question_sw: Mgeni mwenye ruhusa ya ukaazi wa kudumu (permanent residence permit) — ana haki ya kufanya rejareja?
answer_sw: Hapana — ruhusa ya ukaazi wa kudumu (permanent residence) inakuruhusu kuishi Tanzania kwa muda mrefu lakini haikubadilishi hadhi yako ya 'mgeni' kwa madhumuni ya GN 487A. GN 487A inaangalia URAIA wa Tanzania — si hali ya ukaazi. Mgeni mwenye ukaazi wa kudumu bado anakabiliwa na vikwazo vya GN 487A kwa biashara. Njia pekee ya kubadilisha hadhi hii ni kupata uraia wa Tanzania rasmi.
question_en: A non-citizen with a permanent residence permit — do they have the right to conduct retail trade?
answer_en: No — a permanent residence permit allows you to live in Tanzania long-term but does not change your 'non-citizen' status for GN 487A purposes. GN 487A looks at Tanzanian CITIZENSHIP — not residency status. A non-citizen with permanent residence still faces GN 487A restrictions on business. The only way to change this status is to obtain Tanzanian citizenship formally.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Kiwango cha usajili wa OSHA kinaanza kwa wafanyakazi wangapi?
answer_sw: Waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi wanalazimika kusajili mahali pao pa kazi na OSHA kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Usalama na Afya Kazini ya 2003. Biashara zenye wafanyakazi chini ya 10 hazihitajiki rasmi kusajiliwa, ingawa sheria bado inatumika.
question_en: From how many employees does OSHA registration become mandatory?
answer_en: Employers with 10 or more employees must register their workplace with OSHA under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2003. Businesses with fewer than 10 employees are not formally required to register, though the Act's general provisions still apply.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority
next_review_trigger: OSHA Act amendment or threshold change

question_sw: Vifaa vya kinga binafsi (PPE) mfanyakazi anunue mwenyewe — je, mwajiri hana wajibu?
answer_sw: Hapana. Mwajiri analazimika kutoa PPE BILA MALIPO kwa wafanyakazi wanaofanya kazi hatari. Kuwaacha wafanyakazi wanunue PPE wenyewe ni ukiukwaji wa Sheria ya OSHA. Mwajiri ndiye mwenye wajibu mkubwa wa usalama mahali pa kazi.
question_en: Personal protective equipment (PPE) should be bought by the worker themselves — the employer has no obligation?
answer_en: No. The employer is required to provide PPE FREE OF CHARGE to workers in hazardous roles. Requiring workers to buy their own PPE is a violation of the OSHA Act. The employer bears primary responsibility for workplace safety.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

instruction: Biashara yangu ya hoteli — EFD inatumika kwa bili za vyumba tu au chakula pia?
output: EFD inatumika kwa KILA MUAMALA wa biashara — bili za vyumba, chakula, vinywaji, laundry, parking, na huduma zozote za ziada. Hakuna msamaha kwa aina fulani ya huduma ndani ya hoteli moja. Hoteli inahitaji kuhakikisha: (1) EFD inatoa risiti kwa kila bili ya chumba; (2) Migahawa na baa ndani ya hoteli zinatoa risiti za EFD kwa chakula na vinywaji; (3) Huduma za ziada (spa, gym, conference) zinatoa risiti pia. Bila shaka, hoteli zinatoa invoice kubwa kwa makampuni na watu binafsi — hizi lazima ziwe tax invoices za EFD. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

question_sw: Je, biashara ya ujenzi inahitaji OSHA? Hatua gani maalum za usalama zinahitajika?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Ujenzi ni sekta yenye hatari kubwa na inahitaji usajili wa OSHA. Hatua maalum zinajumuisha: matunzio ya scaffolding, ulinzi wa mahandaki, PPE kwa wafanyakazi wote, mafunzo ya usalama, na afisa wa usalama mahali pa kazi. OSHA inafanya ukaguzi wa mara kwa mara kwa maeneo ya ujenzi.
question_en: Does a construction business need OSHA? What specific safety measures are required?
answer_en: Yes. Construction is a high-risk sector and requires OSHA registration. Specific measures include: proper scaffolding, trench protection, PPE for all workers, safety training, and a site safety officer. OSHA conducts frequent inspections of construction sites.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba (interest) Tanzania ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: Kiwango cha kodi ya zuio ya riba ni asilimia 10 kwa wakazi na asilimia 10 kwa wasio wakazi. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: What is the withholding tax rate on interest in Tanzania?
answer_en: The withholding tax rate on interest is 10% for residents and 10% for non-residents. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: Agizo la mshahara wa 2022 bado lina nguvu kwa biashara ndogo ndogo (SME)?
answer_sw: Hapana. Agizo la 2022 lilifutwa kwa waajiri WOTE tarehe 1 Januari 2026 bila kujali ukubwa wa biashara. Hakuna kifungu cha msamaha kwa SME. Waajiri wote — wakubwa na wadogo — lazima wafuate GN 605A kuanzia Januari 2026.
question_en: The 2022 Wage Order is still valid for small businesses (SMEs)?
answer_en: No. The 2022 order was revoked for ALL employers on 1 January 2026 regardless of business size. There is no SME exemption clause. All employers — large and small — must comply with GN 605A from January 2026.

question_sw: Hati ya uhamishaji wa hisa za kampuni (share transfer) ina ushuru wa stempu Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Uhamishaji wa hisa za kampuni Tanzania una ushuru wa stempu. Ushuru huu unahesabiwa kwa asilimia ya thamani ya hisa zinazohamishwa. Kampuni na washirika wanapaswa kuhakikisha hati za uhamishaji wa hisa zimesajiliwa ipasavyo na ushuru wa stempu umelipwa ili uhamishaji uwe na nguvu ya kisheria.
question_en: Does a company share transfer instrument attract stamp duty in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Transfer of company shares in Tanzania attracts stamp duty. This is calculated at a percentage of the value of shares being transferred. Companies and shareholders should ensure share transfer instruments are properly stamped and registered so the transfer has full legal effect.

instruction: Je, tarehe 20 ya mwezi unaofuata ni tarehe ya kutoa certificate ya VAT withholding?

question_sw: Ninasajilishwa VAT sasa hivi — jinsi ya kupata EFD machine?
answer_sw: Baada ya kupata usajilishaji wako wa VAT, unaweza kupata EFD kupitia hatua hizi: 1) Nenda TRA au wasiliana nao kuhusu orodha ya wasambazaji wa EFD walioidhinishwa Tanzania. 2) Nunua au kodi EFD kutoka kwa msambazaji aliyeidhinishwa — usichukue mashine yoyote. 3) Msambazaji ataifunga EFD na kuiandikisha kwenye mfumo wa TRA. 4) Baada ya ufungaji, EFD yako itaunganishwa moja kwa moja na TRA. Gharama za EFD zinatofautiana — thibitisha na msambazaji.
question_en: I am registering for VAT now — how do I get an EFD machine?
answer_en: After receiving your VAT registration, you can obtain an EFD through these steps: 1) Contact TRA for the list of TRA-approved EFD suppliers in Tanzania. 2) Purchase or lease an EFD from an approved supplier — do not use any unregistered device. 3) The supplier will install and register the EFD on TRA's system. 4) After installation, your EFD will be directly linked to TRA. EFD costs vary — confirm with the supplier.

instruction: Qualifying buyer amechukua withholding ya 3% kwa bidhaa — toeni certificate lini?
output: Withholding certificate kwa bidhaa (3%) lazima itolewe SIKU YA MUAMALA — siku pesa zinalipwa au bidhaa zinapokelewa, ikijua ni kipi kinachokuja kwanza kwa muamala huo. Certificate hiyo inaonyesha: kiasi cha VAT kilichokatwa (3% ya bei), tarehe, jina la muuzaji na mnunuzi, na nambari ya TIN. Muuzaji anahitaji certificate hii kusuluhisha akaunti yake ya VAT — anapopokea certificate, anajua ni kiasi gani cha VAT tayari kimekwisha tolewa kwa niaba yake. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa fomu sahihi ya certificate.

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kipindi cha majaribio (probationary) ana haki ya WCF?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Wafanyakazi wa kipindi cha majaribio wana haki ya WCF kwa majeraha yanayotokana na kazi wakati wa kipindi hicho. Hali ya probationary haibadilishi haki za WCF — mfanyakazi yeyote anayefanya kazi kwa mwajiri Tanzania ana haki ya WCF tangu siku ya kwanza.
question_en: Does a probationary employee have WCF rights?
answer_en: Yes. Probationary employees have WCF rights for work-related injuries during the probationary period. Probationary status does not change WCF entitlements — any employee working for a Tanzania employer has WCF rights from day one.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Kiwango cha WHT kwa riba ya benki ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: WHT kwa riba ya benki inayolipwa kwa mkazi ni asilimia 10. Kwa wasio wakazi, kiwango ni pia asilimia 10. Benki inayolipa riba kwenye akaunti ya akiba inalazimika kukata WHT ya asilimia 10 na kuipeleka TRA kabla ya kulipa riba kwa mwenyekiti wa akaunti.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on bank interest?
answer_en: WHT on bank interest paid to a resident is 10%. For non-residents the rate is also 10%. A bank paying interest on a savings account must deduct 10% WHT and remit it to TRA before paying interest to the account holder.

instruction: Mwenzangu alisema BRELA ina aina 16 za biashara — ni kweli?
output: Hapana, si kweli. BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Nambari ya 16 haikuwa sahihi — inaweza kuwa imetoka kwa chanzo kibaya au uelewa mbaya wa kategoria ndogo za kibiashara. Chanzo rasmi pekee ni brela.go.tz.

question_sw: Faini ya kuchelewa kulipa NSSF Tanzania ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Faini ya kuchelewa kulipa NSSF ni asilimia 5 ya kiwango kilichochelewa kwa kila mwezi au sehemu ya mwezi baada ya tarehe ya malipo. Faini inakusanywa kama deni kutoka kwa mwajiri. Thibitisha na NSSF.
question_en: What is the penalty for late NSSF contribution payment in Tanzania?
answer_en: The late NSSF contribution penalty is 5% of the unpaid amount for each month or part of a month after the due date. The penalty is recovered as a debt from the employer. Confirm with NSSF.

question_sw: Mauzo ya exempt na zero-rated — tofauti muhimu kwa madai ya VAT input?
answer_sw: ZERO-RATED (kiwango 0%): Mauzo yanabeba VAT ya 0% — bado ni 'taxable supply'. Input VAT inaweza kudaiwa kwa mauzo haya. Mfano: exports. EXEMPT (sio kodi): Mauzo hayabeba VAT kabisa — nje ya mfumo wa VAT. Input VAT HAIWEZI kudaiwa kwa mauzo ya exempt. Mfano Tanzania: huduma za elimu, afya, mauzo fulani ya ardhi. Tofauti hii ni muhimu sana kwa madai ya input VAT.
question_en: Exempt sales and zero-rated sales — critical difference for input VAT claims?
answer_en: ZERO-RATED (0% rate): Sales carry 0% VAT — still a 'taxable supply'. Input VAT CAN be claimed against these sales. Example: exports. EXEMPT (no tax): Sales carry no VAT at all — outside the VAT system. Input VAT CANNOT be claimed against exempt sales. Tanzania examples: education services, health services, some land sales. This distinction is critical for input VAT claims.

instruction: Biashara ya mgeni ilianzishwa kabla ya GN 487A -- ina hatua gani?
