question_sw: Nina biashara ya usafiri (bodaboda 5) — wapanda bodaboda wangu wana haki ya mshahara wa chini?
answer_sw: Kama wapanda bodaboda wako ni WAFANYAKAZI (unawalipa mshahara), ndio — wana haki ya mshahara wa chini wa GN 605A kwa sekta ya usafiri. Kama ni WAFANYABIASHARA HURU (wanakupa sehemu ya mapato), wanachukuliwa kama wajibu wao wenyewe — si wafanyakazi. Aina ya uhusiano wa ajira ndiyo inayoamua.
question_en: I run a transport business (5 motorbikes) — do my riders have a right to minimum wage?
answer_en: If your riders are EMPLOYEES (you pay them a salary), yes — they have a right to the GN 605A minimum wage for the transport sector. If they are SELF-EMPLOYED (they pay you a share of income), they are treated as independent — not employees. The nature of the employment relationship determines this.
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

question_sw: Biashara ya mauzo ya mtandaoni peke yake (online-only) inahitaji usajili wa BRELA Tanzania?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara yoyote inayofanya shughuli Tanzania — ikiwa ni pamoja na biashara ya mtandaoni peke yake — inahitaji usajili wa kisheria. Ikiwa ni biashara ya mtu mmoja, angalau jina la biashara linapaswa kusajiliwa BRELA. Ikiwa ni kampuni, kampuni lazima isajiliwe BRELA. TIN pia inahitajika. Biashara ya mtandaoni peke yake HAIEPUKI mahitaji ya kisheria ya Tanzania.
question_en: Does an online-only business need BRELA registration in Tanzania?
answer_en: Yes. Any business operating in Tanzania — including an online-only business — needs legal registration. If it is a sole proprietorship, at minimum the business name should be registered at BRELA. If it is a company, the company must be registered at BRELA. A TIN is also required. An online-only business does NOT escape Tanzania's legal registration requirements.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Ninaweza kulipa kodi zangu zote TRA kupitia GePG mtandaoni bila kwenda ofisi?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) inaruhusu kulipa kodi nyingi za TRA mtandaoni bila kwenda ofisi, ikiwa ni pamoja na PAYE, VAT, SDL, kodi ya makisio, na kodi za nyingine. Hatua: (1) Wasilisha return yako kwenye mfumo wa TRA (IDRAS au portal ya TRA) ili kupata nambari ya rejesta ya malipo (PRN). (2) Lipa kupitia benki inayoshiriki na GePG, ATM, internet banking, au simu za pesa (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa). (3) Hifadhi uthibitisho wa malipo kwa rekodi zako. Malipo yanafanyika mara moja na yanachukuliwa kama malipo rasmi.
answer_en: Yes. GePG (Government e-Payment Gateway) allows payment of most TRA taxes online without visiting an office, including PAYE, VAT, SDL, presumptive tax, and other taxes. Steps: (1) File your return on TRA's system (IDRAS or TRA portal) to obtain a payment reference number (PRN). (2) Pay via a GePG-connected bank, ATM, internet banking, or mobile money (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa). (3) Keep the payment confirmation for your records. Payment is processed immediately and treated as official tax payment.
question_en: Can I pay all my TRA taxes via GePG online without visiting an office?
primary_source_name: TRA GePG — online tax payment system

instruction: Kampuni yangu ina wafanyakazi katika sekta nyingi — vipi ninabainisha kiwango cha mshahara kwa kila mmoja?
output: Kila mfanyakazi lazima alipwe kulingana na kiwango cha sekta na subsekta yake maalum kama inavyoainishwa katika GN605A. Huwezi kutumia kiwango kimoja kwa wafanyakazi wote wa sekta tofauti. Hatua: (1) ainisha sekta na subsekta ya kila mfanyakazi kulingana na kazi anayofanya; (2) tazama GN605A kwa kiwango cha sekta hiyo; (3) hakikisha mshahara wake hauteremki chini ya kiwango hicho. Mshauri wa kazi (HR consultant) anaweza kukusaidia.

question_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kurekebisha makosa ya PAYE ya miezi iliyopita vipi?
answer_sw: Mwajiri anaweza kurekebisha makosa ya PAYE ya miezi iliyopita kwa: (1) kuwasilisha marekebisho ya P10 kwa TRA ikionyesha kiasi sahihi, (2) kulipa tofauti pamoja na adhabu na riba inayohusika, na (3) kurekebisha rekodi za wafanyakazi. Ni bora kuwasiliana na TRA mapema kama marekesiho yanahusisha kiasi kikubwa.
question_en: How can an employer correct past PAYE errors for previous months?
answer_en: An employer can correct past PAYE errors by: (1) submitting an amended P10 to TRA showing the correct amount, (2) paying the difference plus applicable penalties and interest, and (3) correcting employee records. It is advisable to contact TRA early if the correction involves a significant amount.

question_sw: Sheria ya OSHA inasema nini kuhusu usalama wa moto (fire safety)?
answer_sw: Waajiri wanalazimika kuhakikisha: vizima moto (fire extinguishers) vipo na vimekaguliwa, njia za kutoka kwa dharura (emergency exits) ziko wazi na zina alama, mafunzo ya dharura yanatolewa kwa wafanyakazi, na mpango wa uokoaji (evacuation plan) upo.
question_en: What does the OSHA Act say about fire safety?
answer_en: Employers must ensure: fire extinguishers are present and inspected, emergency exits are clear and marked, evacuation drills are provided to employees, and an evacuation plan is in place.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority

question_sw: WHT inaweza kulipwa kwa nguzo ya bidhaa (in-kind) badala ya pesa — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. WHT ni ushuru wa pesa taslimu na lazima ulipwe TRA kwa pesa — si kwa bidhaa au huduma. Hata kama malipo ya asili yaliyotoza WHT yalikuwa ya bidhaa (in-kind), WHT lazima ihesabiwe kwa thamani ya bidhaa na kulipwa TRA kwa pesa.
question_en: WHT can be paid in kind (goods instead of cash) instead of money — is this true?
answer_en: No. WHT is a cash tax and must be paid to TRA in money — not in goods or services. Even if the original payment that triggered WHT was in kind, WHT must be calculated at the market value of the goods and paid to TRA in cash.

question_sw: Kampuni ya Tanzania inamilikiwa na kampuni mama ya nje. Sheria ya kuzuia uchepushwaji wa faida (thin capitalisation) inaathiri vipi mkopo kutoka kwa kampuni mama?
answer_sw: Sheria ya udhaifu wa mtaji (thin capitalisation) Tanzania inazuia ukato wa riba inayolipwa kwa mmiliki wa nje ikiwa deni la kampuni linazidi mara tatu ya mtaji wake (uwiano wa 3:1 wa deni kwa mtaji). Riba inayolipwa kwenye deni linalozidi kikomo hiki haiwezi kukatwa kama gharama ya biashara. Kanuni hii inalenga kuzuia kampuni za kimataifa kupeleka faida nje ya Tanzania kwa njia ya mikopo ya bandia yenye riba kubwa. Thibitisha muundo wako wa fedha na mshauri wa kodi.
answer_en: Tanzania's thin capitalisation rules limit the deductibility of interest paid to a foreign parent company if the company's debt exceeds three times its equity (3:1 debt-to-equity ratio). Interest on debt exceeding this limit cannot be deducted as a business expense. This rule is designed to prevent multinational companies from shifting profits out of Tanzania through artificial high-interest loans. Confirm your financing structure with a tax consultant.
question_en: A Tanzanian company is owned by a foreign parent. How does the thin capitalisation rule affect loans from the parent company?

instruction: GN605A ilianza lini na ilifutwa amri gani?

Ilifuta kabisa Amri ya Mshahara wa Chini ya Sekta Binafsi ya mwaka 2022 — amri hiyo ya 2022 haina nguvu yoyote ya kisheria tangu tarehe 31 Desemba 2025. question_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya mwisho (final withholding tax) na isiyo ya mwisho (non-final) ni tofauti gani?
answer_sw: Kodi ya zuio ya mwisho: mpokeaji haawezi kudai mkopo wa kodi — kodi hiyo ndiyo ya mwisho kabisa kwa mapato hayo. Kodi ya zuio isiyo ya mwisho: mpokeaji anaweza kudai mkopo dhidi ya kodi yake ya mwaka. Thibitisha hali ya malipo yako na TRA.
question_en: What is the difference between final and non-final withholding tax in Tanzania?
answer_en: Final withholding tax: the recipient cannot claim a tax credit — it is the final tax on that income. Non-final withholding tax: the recipient can claim a credit against their annual tax liability. Confirm your payment classification with TRA.

question_sw: NSSF imetoa tathmini ya michango ya ziada dhidi ya kampuni yangu ambayo naona ni makosa. Naweza kupinga vipi?
answer_sw: Unaweza kupinga tathmini ya NSSF kwa njia zifuatazo: kwanza, wasiliana na ofisi ya NSSF kwa maandishi ndani ya siku 30 baada ya kupokea tathmini, ukitoa ushahidi wa payroll yako halisi (rekodi za mshahara, slips za malipo, na rekodi za benki). Ikiwa tathmini bado hairidhishi, unaweza kupiga rufaa kwa Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa NSSF. Kama bado hujaridhika, uzo unaendelea hadi Mahakama ya Kazi (Labour Court). Hifadhi rekodi zote za malipo ya NSSF na mishahara kwa miaka 5 ili kujibu tathmini.
answer_en: You can dispute an NSSF assessment in these steps: first, contact the NSSF office in writing within 30 days of receiving the assessment, providing evidence of your actual payroll (salary records, payslips, and bank records). If the assessment is still unsatisfactory, you can appeal to the NSSF Director General. If still unsatisfied, the dispute proceeds to the Labour Court. Keep all NSSF payment and salary records for 5 years to respond to assessments.
question_en: NSSF has issued an excess contribution assessment against my company that I believe is wrong. How can I dispute it?

question_sw: Kanda ya PAYE ya asilimia 20 inaanza kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 500,001 kwa mwezi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kanda ya asilimia 20 inaanza kwa mshahara wa Shilingi 520,001 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 500,001. Kanda kamili ni: 0% (hadi 270,000), 8% (270,001–520,000), 20% (520,001–760,000), 25% (760,001–1,000,000), 30% (zaidi ya 1,000,000). Namba ya Shilingi 500,001 si sahihi.
question_en: The 20% PAYE band starts at TZS 500,001 per month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The 20% band starts at TZS 520,001 per month — not TZS 500,001. The full bands are: 0% (up to 270,000), 8% (270,001–520,000), 20% (520,001–760,000), 25% (760,001–1,000,000), 30% (above 1,000,000). The figure of TZS 500,001 is incorrect.

question_sw: Biashara inayofanya mauzo ya mara moja tu kwa mwaka (seasonal business) ina wajibu wa kodi wa kila mwezi Tanzania?
answer_sw: Biashara ya msimu (seasonal) bado ina wajibu wa kodi wa kila mwezi ikiwa ina wafanyakazi: PAYE, NSSF, SDL (ikiwa ≥10) zinawasilishwa kila mwezi. Hata hivyo, kwa miezi ya biashara isipo na shughuli, PAYE na SDL ni sifuri ikiwa hakuna mshahara uliolipwa. Tamko la kodi la mwaka linawasilishwa mwaka mzima hata kama biashara ilifanya kazi miezi 3 tu. Mfumo wa TRA hautambui 'biashara ya msimu' kama aina maalum — sheria za kawaida zinatumika.
question_en: A business that sells only once a year (seasonal business) — does it have monthly tax obligations in Tanzania?
answer_en: A seasonal business still has monthly tax obligations if it has employees: PAYE, NSSF, SDL (if ≥10) are submitted monthly. However, during months with no business activity, PAYE and SDL are zero if no wages were paid. An annual tax return is filed for the full year even if the business only operated for 3 months. TRA's system does not recognise 'seasonal business' as a special category — standard rules apply.

question_sw: Mwajiri aliyesajili OSHA hahitaji tena kufanya tathmini ya hatari (risk assessment) — OSHA inafanya hiyo mwenyewe — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Tathmini ya hatari (risk assessment) ni WAJIBU WA MWAJIRI — si OSHA. Mwajiri ana jukumu la kutambua hatari za mahali pa kazi, kutathmini hatari hizo, kuweka hatua za kudhibiti, na kuandika ripoti. OSHA inakagua kwamba mwajiri amefanya tathmini ya hatari ipasavyo na inatekeleza sheria ikiwa haijafanywa. Usajili wa OSHA hauondoi wajibu wa mwajiri wa tathmini ya hatari.
question_en: An employer registered with OSHA doesn't need to do a risk assessment anymore — OSHA does that themselves — is this correct?
answer_en: No. Risk assessment is the EMPLOYER'S OBLIGATION — not OSHA's. The employer has a duty to identify workplace hazards, assess those risks, put control measures in place, and document the assessment. OSHA inspects that the employer has properly conducted a risk assessment and enforces compliance if not done. OSHA registration does not remove the employer's risk assessment obligation.
primary_source_name: OSHA — Occupational Safety and Health Authority Tanzania

question_sw: Ninaendesha duka la mtandaoni. Je, VFD inatumika badala ya EFD ya kimwili?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Biashara za mtandaoni zilizosajiliwa kwa VAT zinatumia VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device) — programu inayofanya kazi ya EFD bila kifaa cha kimwili. VFD inatolewa na watoa huduma walioidhinishwa na TRA. Kwa kila muamala wa mauzo ya mtandaoni, VFD inazalisha risiti ya kidijitali inayopelekwa kwa mteja na wakati huo huo inayo taarifa inayowasilishwa seva ya TRA.
question_en: I run an online shop. Does VFD replace the physical EFD?
answer_en: Yes. Online businesses registered for VAT use VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device) — software that performs the EFD function without a physical device. VFD is provided by TRA-approved service providers. For each online sales transaction, the VFD generates a digital receipt that is sent to the customer and simultaneously transmits data to TRA's server.

question_sw: TIN (Tax Identification Number) na leseni ya biashara — ni vitu sawa?
answer_sw: Hapana. TIN (Nambari ya Utambulisho wa Kodi) ni nambari ya TRA inayotambulisha mlipa kodi — inatumika kwa kodi zote. Leseni ya biashara ni hati inayoruhusiwa biashara kufanya shughuli fulani — inatoka kwa halmashauri au mamlaka husika. Biashara inahitaji ZOTE MBILI: TIN kwa TRA na leseni ya biashara kwa halmashauri.
question_en: TIN (Tax Identification Number) and a business licence — are they the same thing?
answer_en: No. A TIN (Tax Identification Number) is a TRA number that identifies a taxpayer — used for all taxes. A business licence is a document permitting a business to conduct specific activities — it comes from the local council or relevant authority. A business needs BOTH: a TIN for TRA and a business licence from the council.

question_sw: Niliambiwa kwamba hoteli na migahawa inalipa VAT ya asilimia 5 kwa chakula kinachouzwa. Je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Hakuna kiwango maalum cha VAT cha asilimia 5 kwa hoteli au migahawa. Hoteli na migahawa zilizosajiliwa kwa VAT zinatozwa kiwango cha kawaida cha asilimia 18 kwenye mauzo yao. Hakuna kiwango cha kati cha asilimia 5 au asilimia 10 Tanzania Bara.
question_en: I was told hotels and restaurants pay 5% VAT on food sold. Is this true?
answer_en: No. There is no special 5% VAT rate for hotels or restaurants. VAT-registered hotels and restaurants charge the standard 18% rate on their sales. There is no intermediate rate of 5% or 10% on Mainland Tanzania.

question_sw: STR ni utaratibu wa nchi moja au wa kikanda?
answer_sw: STR ni utaratibu wa kikanda — inatekelezwa kwa pamoja na nchi wanachama wa EAC na COMESA. Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, Zambia na nchi nyingine zinashiriki. Hii inamaanisha mfanyabiashara wa Tanzania anaweza kutumia STR wakati wa biashara na nchi yoyote mwanachama inayoshiriki.
question_en: Is STR a single-country or regional arrangement?
answer_en: STR is a regional arrangement — jointly implemented by EAC and COMESA member states. Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, DRC, Zambia and other countries participate. This means a Tanzanian trader can use STR when trading with any participating member state.

question_sw: Kibali cha Darasa C (muda mfupi) kinamaanisha nini na kinatumika kwa nini?
answer_sw: Kibali cha Darasa C ni kibali cha kazi cha muda mfupi kinachotolewa kwa wageni wanaofanya kazi ya mkataba wa muda maalum Tanzania. Kinatumika kwa: wataalam wa muda mfupi wanaokuja kufanya mradi maalum, washauri wa kimataifa, na watendaji wa mkataba wa muda. Muda wake ni mfupi kuliko Darasa B.
question_en: What is a Class C (short-term) permit and when is it used?
answer_en: A Class C permit is a short-term work permit for foreigners performing fixed-term contract work in Tanzania. It is used for: short-term specialists coming to complete a specific project, international consultants, and fixed-term contract workers. Its duration is shorter than a Class B permit.

question_sw: Kodi ya awali ya PAYE ya Shilingi sifuri inaendelea hadi mshahara wa Shilingi 300,000 kwa mwezi — je, hii ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. Kanda ya asilimia sifuri ya PAYE inaendelea hadi Shilingi 270,000 kwa mwezi — si Shilingi 300,000. Mapato yanayozidi Shilingi 270,000 yanaanza kupigwa kodi ya asilimia 8 (kanda ya pili). Kiwango cha Shilingi 300,000 si sahihi.
question_en: The zero-rate PAYE band continues up to TZS 300,000 per month — is this correct?
answer_en: No. The zero-rate PAYE band runs up to TZS 270,000 per month — not TZS 300,000. Income above TZS 270,000 starts being taxed at 8% (second band). The figure of TZS 300,000 is incorrect.

instruction: Je, mfanyakazi anaweza kukataa mchango wake wa NSSF?
output: Hapana. Uanachama wa NSSF ni wa lazima kwa wafanyakazi wote wa sekta binafsi Tanzania — si chaguo. Mwajiri lazima asajili mfanyakazi katika NSSF mara tu anapoanza kazi. Mfanyakazi hawezi kuomba kutokuwa mwanachama. Kutowasilisha mchango wa NSSF ni ukiukwaji wa kisheria ambao unaweza kusababisha adhabu kwa mwajiri.

question_sw: WHT kwa bima (insurance premiums) ni asilimia ngapi?
answer_sw: WHT kwa malipo ya bima ni asilimia 5. Hii inatumika kwa malipo ya premium ya bima yanayolipwa kwa kampuni za bima. Kiwango hiki kinatumika bila kujali kama kampuni ya bima ni ya ndani au ya kigeni.
question_en: What is the WHT rate on insurance premiums?
answer_en: WHT on insurance premium payments is 5%. This applies to insurance premium payments made to insurance companies. This rate applies regardless of whether the insurance company is domestic or foreign.

question_sw: Adhabu ya ukiukwaji wa sheria ya OSHA ni nini?
answer_sw: Ukiukwaji wa Sheria ya Usalama na Afya Kazini ya 2003 unaweza kusababisha: faini, kufungwa kwa mahali pa kazi, au kifungo cha jela. Makosa ya jinai kama kutokuripoti ajali ya kifo yana adhabu kali zaidi. Mwajiri mwenye historia ya ukiukwaji ana hatari ya adhabu kubwa zaidi.
question_en: What is the penalty for violating the OSHA Act?
answer_en: Violations of the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2003 can result in: fines, workplace closure, or imprisonment. Criminal offences such as failing to report a fatal accident carry heavier penalties. An employer with a history of violations faces higher penalties.

instruction: Certificate of Incorporation ni nini na inathibitisha nini?

question_sw: Mwajiriwa anaweza kuchagua kutosajiliwa NSSF ikiwa anataka — ni hiari ya mfanyakazi — je, ni sahihi?
answer_sw: Hapana. NSSF ni LAZIMA kwa wafanyakazi wote walioajiriwa Tanzania bila kujali tamaa ya mfanyakazi. Mwajiri hawezi kumruhusu mfanyakazi 'ajiepushe' na NSSF. Mfanyakazi hawezi kuomba kutosajiliwa. Mwajiri ana wajibu wa kisheria wa kusajili kila mfanyakazi na kukata mchango wa NSSF (10% ya mfanyakazi + 10% ya mwajiri). Kutosajili mfanyakazi ni ukiukwaji wa Sheria ya NSSF.
question_en: An employee can choose not to register with NSSF if they want — it is the worker's choice — is this correct?
answer_en: No. NSSF is MANDATORY for all employed workers in Tanzania regardless of the worker's preference. An employer cannot allow a worker to 'opt out' of NSSF. A worker cannot request not to be registered. The employer has a legal obligation to register every employee and deduct NSSF contributions (10% employee + 10% employer). Not registering an employee is a violation of the NSSF Act.
primary_source_name: NSSF — National Social Security Fund Tanzania

instruction: Kampuni yangu ilisajiliwa mwezi Machi — annual return yangu inaisha lini?
output: Hakuna tarehe maalum ya 30 Septemba kwa annual returns za BRELA — tarehe inategemea tarehe ya usajili wa kampuni yako. Annual return inapaswa kuwasilishwa kulingana na tarehe ya kumbukumbu ya usajili wa kampuni yako (anniversary date) — si lazima mwaka wa kifedha. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz) kwa tarehe yako halisi. Kwa kampuni iliyosajiliwa mwezi Machi, mwaka wako wa biashara utategemea tarehe ya cheti chako cha usajili. question_sw: WCF inalipa gharama za matibabu zote bila kikomo — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Si kweli kabisa. WCF inalipia gharama za matibabu zinazohusiana na jeraha la kazi, lakini kuna mipaka na masharti kulingana na sheria na miongozo ya WCF. Gharama zinazohusiana moja kwa moja na jeraha la kazi zinafunikwa; gharama za hali za awali za kiafya au matibabu yasiyohusiana hazifunikwi.
question_en: WCF pays all medical costs without limit — is this true?
answer_en: Not entirely. WCF pays medical costs related to the work injury, but there are limits and conditions under the law and WCF guidelines. Costs directly related to the work injury are covered; costs for pre-existing conditions or unrelated treatment are not.

instruction: Kampuni yangu ndogo ina wafanyakazi 3 tu — nchi ina kanuni ya NSSF?
output: NSSF inahitaji mchango wa jumla wa 20% ya mshahara kwa kila mwezi. Mgawanyo unaoruhusiwa: mwajiri 10% + mfanyakazi 10% (mpango wa kawaida), au mwajiri 15% + mfanyakazi 5%, au mwajiri 20% + mfanyakazi 0% (mwajiri anabeba yote). Jumla lazima iwe 20% — hii ndiyo inayohitajika kisheria. Hata mwajiri mwenye mfanyakazi mmoja lazima asajili NSSF — hakuna kizingiti cha idadi ya wafanyakazi. Ndio — hata wafanyakazi 3 wanastahili NSSF. Hakuna kizingiti cha ukubwa. Ukiwa na wafanyakazi 3, unapaswa: (1) Sajili kampuni yako kwa NSSF (nssf.go.tz). (2) Sajili wafanyakazi wako wote. (3) Lipa NSSF kila mwezi (10% mwajiri + 10% mfanyakazi).

instruction: CPA aliyesajiliwa Tanzania lazima asajili VAT — hata mapato yake ni TZS 30M tu?
output: Ndiyo — TRA inasema wanachama wa taaluma maalum zilizo na usajili wa kitaalamu (kama CPAs, lawyers, engineers, architects) WANAWEZA kulazimishwa kusajili VAT bila kujali kiasi cha mapato — hata chini ya kizingiti cha TZS 200M. Hii inatokana na dhana kwamba taaluma hizi zinatoa huduma za kibiashara ambazo zimebainishwa. CPA aliyesajiliwa na NBAA (National Board of Accountants and Auditors) Tanzania anashauriwa kuwasiliana na TRA haraka kuhusu wajibu wake wa VAT — bila kujali mapato yake ni TZS 30M.  RSM Tanzania Tax Guide 2025/26 inathibitisha: mtu aliyeruhusiwa, kusajiliwa, au kuandikishwa kutoa huduma za kitaaluma lazima asajili VAT bila kujali kiasi cha mapato. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa orodha kamili ya taaluma zinazolazimishwa. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) na NBAA.

instruction: Mteja mmoja amewasilisha malalamiko TRA kwamba sijatoa risiti — nini kitatokea kwangu?

instruction: Tofauti kati ya OSHA na WCF ni nini? Zote mbili zinasimamia ajali — zinahusiana vipi?
output: Tofauti kati ya OSHA, WCF, na NSSF: OSHA = kuzuia ajali na usalama mahali pa kazi (prevention/regulation). WCF = kulipa fidia baada ya ajali ya kazi (compensation). NSSF = pensheni na usalama wa jamii wa muda mrefu (pension/social security). Mahusiano yao: OSHA inajaribu KUZUIA ajali isitokee. WCF inalipia fidia BAADA YA ajali kutokea. Mfano: mfanyakazi anaanguka na kuumia → OSHA inakagua kama mahali pa kazi kilikuwa salama, WCF inalipa fidia kwa mfanyakazi aliyeumia.

instruction: SDL inahesabiwaje? Ni mwajiri au mfanyakazi analipa?
output: SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Mfanyakazi HALIPIWI SDL kwenye mshahara wake — mwajiri ndiye analipa kwa jina lake mwenyewe. Mfano: wafanyakazi 10 wenye jumla ya mishahara TZS 3,000,000 → SDL = TZS 105,000.

instruction: EFD inaweza kutoa risiti kwa lugha ya Kiingereza au lazima iwe Kiswahili?
output: Risiti za EFD zinaweza kuwa kwa Kiingereza au Kiswahili — thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kuhusu mahitaji ya lugha kwa risiti za EFD, kwani mwongozo rasmi wa TRA utathibitisha kama Kiswahili au Kiingereza zinakubalika. Muhimu zaidi ni: risiti iwe na taarifa zote zinazohitajika (jina la biashara, TIN, TRA registration number, tarehe, kiasi, aina ya bidhaa/huduma, na TRA verification code). Biashara nyingi za Tanzania zinatoa risiti kwa Kiingereza kwa sababu EFD nyingi zina programu ya Kiingereza. Wateja wanaohitaji risiti kwa Kiswahili wanaweza kuomba — lakini sheria hailazimishi lugha maalum. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa miongozo ya hali ya sasa ya lugha inayokubalika kwa risiti za EFD.

instruction: Nikilinganisha viwango vya VAT Kenya na Tanzania — Tanzania ina viwango vingapi?
output: Tanzania: viwango VITATU. Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kenya (kwa ulinganisho): 0%, 8% (bidhaa chache kama petroli), 16% (standard). Tofauti muhimu: Tanzania HAINA 8% wala 5% — viwango vya Kenya havitumiki Tanzania. Usijaribu kutumia viwango vya Kenya kwa biashara yako Tanzania.

question_sw: Je, kizingiti cha usajili wa VAT kinatumika kwa biashara za kidijitali?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Kizingiti cha VAT Tanzania (TZS 200M/mwaka au TZS 100M/miezi 6) kinatumika kwa biashara zote — za kidijitali NA za kimwili. Biashara ya mtandaoni inayofikia kizingiti hiki lazima isajiliwe kwa VAT kama kampuni yoyote nyingine.
question_en: Does the VAT registration threshold apply to digital businesses?
answer_en: Yes. Tanzania's VAT registration threshold (TZS 200M/year or TZS 100M/6 months) applies to all businesses — digital AND physical. An online business reaching this threshold must register for VAT like any other company.

question_sw: Kampuni inabadilisha mkurugenzi wake (director). Mchakato wa BRELA ni upi?
answer_sw: Kubadilisha mkurugenzi wa kampuni kunahitaji: uamuzi wa bodi (board resolution) ukimteua mkurugenzi mpya na kumalizia mamlaka ya mkurugenzi wa zamani, kuwasilisha Fomu 23 (Taarifa ya Mabadiliko ya Wakurugenzi) kwa BRELA ndani ya siku 14 baada ya mabadiliko (thibitisha nambari ya sasa ya fomu kupitia mfumo wa BRELA Online (brela.go.tz) kwani nambari za fomu zinaweza kubadilika), kulipa ada inayohusiana, na kuwasilisha hati za utambulisho za mkurugenzi mpya. BRELA itasasisha rekodi na kutoa uthibitisho. Kuchelewa kuwasilisha mabadiliko kunasababisha adhabu.
answer_en: Changing a company director requires: a board resolution appointing the new director and ending the authority of the outgoing director, filing Form 23 (Notice of Change of Directors) with BRELA within 14 days of the change (confirm current form number via BRELA Online at brela.go.tz as form numbers may have changed), paying the associated fee, and submitting identification documents of the new director. BRELA will update the records and issue confirmation. Late filing of changes attracts penalties.
question_en: A company is changing its director. What is the BRELA process?

instruction: Mzigo wa bidhaa unaoingia Tanzania kutoka nje — withholding ya VAT inatumika?
output: VAT withholding (3%/6%) inalenga MAUZO YA NDANI ya Tanzania kati ya qualifying buyer na muuzaji wa Tanzania. Bidhaa zinazoingizwa kutoka nje zinalipa VAT ya forodha (customs VAT) wakati wa kuingia nchini — mfumo tofauti. Withholding ya VAT ya ndani haihusiki na mauzo ya forodha/import. Hata hivyo, baadaye muuzaji wa Tanzania anayezisambaza bidhaa hizo ndani ya nchi — mauzo ya ndani yanaweza kuwa na withholding kwa qualifying buyer. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) kwa mwongozo maalum wa bidhaa za kuagiza na VAT.

question_sw: CPA aliyestaafu kazi bado ana leseni yake ya NBAA. Anahitaji kudumisha usajili wa VAT?
answer_sw: Kama CPA aliyestaafu bado ana leseni hai ya NBAA na bado anafanya kazi yoyote ya uhasibu au ukaguzi — hata kwa wateja wachache — usajili wa VAT bado unatumika. Kama amestaafu kabisa na HAJAFANYI biashara yoyote ya kitaalamu, anaweza kuomba TRA kufuta usajili wake wa VAT kwa mujibu wa taratibu sahihi. Hata hivyo, kuwa na leseni inayoendelea bila kufanya kazi mara nyingi si tatizo la VAT — tatizo linatokea ukifanya kazi bila usajili.
question_en: A retired CPA still holds their active NBAA licence. Do they need to maintain VAT registration?
answer_en: If a retired CPA still holds an active NBAA licence and is still doing any accounting or auditing work — even for a few clients — VAT registration still applies. If fully retired and NOT conducting any professional business, they may apply to TRA to deregister their VAT following proper procedures. However, holding a continuing licence while not working is generally not a VAT problem — the problem arises if working without registration.

question_sw: Adhabu ya GN 487A kwa mgeni ni TZS 10M tu — hii ni ndogo sana kwa biashara kubwa ya jumla. Je, kuna adhabu nyingine?
answer_sw: TZS 10M ni faini ya CHINI KABISA — korti inaweza kutoza zaidi. Aidha, adhabu za GN 487A si adhabu pekee: TZS 10M ni faini ya CHINI KABISA — korti inaweza kutoza zaidi. Kifungu cha adhabu cha GN 487A kinabainisha hasa: faini ya angalau TZS 10M AU kifungo hadi miezi 6 NA visa kufutwa. Matokeo kama kunyang'anywa kwa bidhaa, kufutwa kwa leseni, au kufukuzwa HAYATAJWI wazi katika GN 487A yenyewe — yanaweza kutokea chini ya sheria nyingine za Tanzania lakini hayapaswi kuwasilishwa kama adhabu za GN 487A. Thibitisha na wakili kwa hali yako mahususi.
question_en: The GN 487A penalty for a non-citizen is only TZS 10M — this seems small for a large wholesale business. Are there other penalties?
answer_en: TZS 10M is the MINIMUM fine — a court may impose more. Also, GN 487A penalties are not the only consequences: TZS 10M is the MINIMUM fine — a court may impose more. The GN 487A penalty clause specifies exactly: fine of at least TZS 10M OR imprisonment up to 6 months AND visa revocation. Consequences such as goods forfeiture, business licence cancellation, or deportation are NOT expressly stated in GN 487A — they may arise under other Tanzanian laws (Business Licensing Act, Immigration Act) but should not be presented as GN 487A penalties. Consult a lawyer for the full picture in your specific situation.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni (expatriate) analipa PAYE Tanzania kwa njia gani?
answer_sw: Mfanyakazi wa kigeni anayefanya kazi Tanzania na kupata mshahara Tanzania analipa PAYE kwa njia ile ile ya wafanyakazi wa ndani — mwajiri anakata PAYE na kulipa TRA kila mwezi. Ikiwa mfanyakazi ana makao makuu Tanzania, analipa kodi ya mapato yote duniani. Mikataba ya kuepuka kutozwa kodi mara mbili (DTAs) inaweza kutoa uondoaji kwa nchi fulani.
question_en: How does a foreign (expatriate) employee pay PAYE in Tanzania?
answer_en: A foreign employee working in Tanzania and receiving a Tanzania salary pays PAYE the same way as local employees — the employer deducts PAYE and remits to TRA monthly. If the employee has permanent establishment in Tanzania, worldwide income may be taxable. Double Taxation Agreements (DTAs) may provide relief for specific countries.

instruction: Biashara yangu inafanya kazi Zanzibar na Tanzania Bara — ninajisajili vipi na ninalipa kodi wapi?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa kwa upande wa Zanzibar. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia Tanzania Bara peke yake. Biashara inayofanya kazi katika maeneo yote mawili inahitaji usajili tofauti — TRA kwa Tanzania Bara na ZRB kwa Zanzibar. Mahitaji maalum ya hali hii yanahitaji ushauri maalum. Wasiliana na ZRB kupitia zrb.go.tz, TRA kupitia tra.go.tz, au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu.

question_sw: Adhabu ya mgeni anayevunja GN 487A ni nini hasa?
answer_sw: Adhabu rasmi kwa mtu asiye raia wa Tanzania anayevunja GN 487A ni: (1) Faini ya angalau TZS milioni 10 (shilingi milioni kumi), (2) Kifungo cha hadi miezi 6 jela (si zaidi ya miezi sita), na (3) Kufutwa kwa viza yake na kurushwa nje ya nchi. Adhabu hizi zinaweza kutolewa pamoja au moja kwa moja. Kumbuka: Faini ya TZS milioni 10 ni kiwango cha CHINI — mahakama inaweza kutoa faini kubwa zaidi. Vyanzo vilivyothibitishwa: Bowmans (30 Jul 2025), Dentons (29 Jul 2025), DLA Piper Africa.
question_en: What exactly are the penalties for a foreigner violating GN 487A?
answer_en: The official penalties for a non-Tanzanian citizen violating GN 487A are: (1) A minimum TZS 10 million fine, (2) Imprisonment for up to 6 months (not exceeding six months), and (3) Visa revocation and deportation. These penalties may be applied together or individually. Note: The TZS 10 million fine is the MINIMUM — courts may impose a higher amount. Verified sources: Bowmans (30 Jul 2025), Dentons (29 Jul 2025), DLA Piper Africa.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kutoa ripoti ya ajali kwa WCF kwa fomu gani?
answer_sw: Mwajiri analazimika kuwasilisha ripoti ya ajali kwa WCF ukitumia fomu rasmi za WCF. Fomu hizi zinapatikana kwenye ofisi za WCF au tovuti. Ripoti inajumuisha: tarehe na hali ya ajali, maelezo ya majeraha, na hatua zilizochukuliwa. Kuwasilisha ndani ya siku saba (7) ZA KAZI ni lazima — kwa njia ya portal ya WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz). (Kwa magonjwa yanayotokana na kazi, muda tofauti unatumika.)
question_en: What form must an employer use to submit an accident report to WCF?
answer_en: The employer must submit an accident report using WCF's official forms, available at WCF offices or their website. The report includes: date and circumstances of the accident, description of injuries, and steps taken. Submission within 7 WORKING DAYS is mandatory — through the WCF online portal (portal.wcf.go.tz). (A different deadline applies for occupational illness reports.)
primary_source_name: Ministry of Labour, Youth, Women and Special Groups

instruction: Mshahara wa chini kabisa ambao haulipiwi PAYE Tanzania ni ngapi?
output: Kizingiti cha mshahara usiolipiwa PAYE ni TZS 270,000 kwa mwezi (au TZS 3,240,000 kwa mwaka). Mshahara wa TZS 270,000 au chini: PAYE = TZS 0 (ipo kabisa ndani ya Bendi 1 ya 0%). Mshahara wa TZS 270,001 na zaidi: PAYE inaanza kwenye ziada ya TZS 1 tu (× 8% = TZS 0.08). MUHIMU: Hakuna msamaha maalum wa TZS 26,000/mwezi — kizingiti cha TZS 270,000 NDIYO msamaha wenyewe. Vipande vya PAYE (kwa mwezi): Bendi 1 (0%): TZS 0 – 270,000 Bendi 2 (8%): TZS 270,001 – 520,000 Bendi 3 (20%): TZS 520,001 – 760,000 Bendi 4 (25%): TZS 760,001 – 1,000,000 Bendi 5 (30%): TZS 1,000,001 na zaidi.

question_sw: SDL inahesabiwa kwa mshahara mzima au mshahara wa msingi (basic salary) tu?
answer_sw: SDL inahesabiwa kwa jumla ya mishahara ya gross — ikiwa ni pamoja na mshahara wa msingi, posho za kila aina (housing, transport, meal), na malipo mengine ya kawaida. Si mshahara wa msingi peke yake. Jumla ya payroll ndiyo msingi.
question_en: Is SDL calculated on total salary or basic salary only?
answer_en: SDL is calculated on total gross payroll — including basic salary, all types of allowances (housing, transport, meals), and other regular payments. Not basic salary alone. The total payroll is the base.

question_sw: Je, mwajiri anaweza kulipa mshahara mdogo kuliko GN 605A kama mfanyakazi amekubali?
answer_sw: Hapana. Makubaliano ya mtu mmoja mmoja hayawezi kupunguza haki ya kisheria ya mshahara wa chini. GN 605A ni kiwango cha chini kabisa — hata kama mfanyakazi 'amekubali' kulipwa kidogo, makubaliano hayo si ya kisheria na hayafai.
question_en: Can an employer pay below GN 605A if the employee agrees?
answer_en: No. Individual agreements cannot reduce the statutory minimum wage entitlement. GN 605A is an absolute floor — even if an employee 'agrees' to less, that agreement is void and unenforceable.

instruction: Katika GN 487A, 'msaidizi' (facilitator) ni nani hasa?
output: Msaidizi ni raia wa Tanzania anayemsaidia au kumwezesha mgeni kufanya biashara yoyote iliyokatazwa chini ya GN 487A. Hii inajumuisha kukopa jina lake, leseni yake, au utambulisho wake ili kumruhusu mgeni kuendesha biashara iliyokatazwa. Msaidizi anakabiliwa na adhabu ya faini ya TZS 5,000,000 AU kifungo cha hadi miezi 3. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji.
system: Jina lako ni Chike, mshauri wa biashara kutoka Africa Giants. Kauli mbiu yako ni: Fahamu Biashara Yako, Maarifa Yako. Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

question_sw: Wakati TRA inakagua PAYE ya kampuni yangu, wanakagua nini hasa?
answer_sw: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa PAYE, TRA wanakagua: orodha ya mishahara (payroll) kwa miaka yote inayopitiwa, rekodi za benki za malipo ya mshahara, mikataba ya ajira ya wafanyakazi, return za PAYE zilizowasilishwa, fomu za P9 zilizotolewa kwa wafanyakazi, vielelezo vya michango ya ziada kama posho za nyumba na usafiri, na malipo yoyote yanayosemekana kuwa ya 'mkopo' au 'kama ada'. Tofauti kati ya rekodi za benki na payroll ni dalili kuu ya udanganyifu.
answer_en: During a PAYE audit, TRA examines: payroll records for all years under review, bank statements showing salary payments, employment contracts, submitted PAYE returns, P9 forms issued to employees, documentation for additional payments such as housing and transport allowances, and any payments classified as 'loans' or 'fees'. Discrepancies between bank records and the payroll are a key fraud indicator.
question_en: When TRA audits our company's PAYE, what exactly do they examine?

instruction: Je, kampuni inayokosa kuwasilisha annual return BRELA inaweza bado kufungua akaunti ya benki?
output: Hapana kwa urahisi — benki nyingi Tanzania zinahitaji uthibitisho wa hali ya sasa (certificate of good standing au hati inayoonyesha kampuni hai) kutoka BRELA kabla ya kufungua akaunti au kuendelea na huduma. Kampuni inayokosa annual return za hivi karibuni itaonekana vibaya katika rekodi za BRELA na inaweza kushindwa kupata uthibitisho huo. Zaidi ya hayo, kama kampuni imefutwa orodha, kisheria haiwezi kufanya shughuli za benki. Weka annual return sasa hivi. Thibitisha na BRELA.go.tz.

question_sw: Kodi ya chini ya lazima (alternative minimum tax) Tanzania ni nini?
answer_sw: Tanzania ina mfumo wa kodi ya chini ya lazima (AMT) ambao unaweza kutumika kwa kampuni ambazo zinadai hasara au vikato vingi vya kodi na hazilipaji kodi yoyote kwa miaka mingi. Kwa mujibu wa Sheria ya Kodi ya Mapato, kampuni zinazopata mapato ghafi ya zaidi ya kiasi fulani lakini zinadai kutolipa kodi zinaweza kulazimishwa kulipa kiwango cha chini. Maelezo kamili ya mfumo huu na vizingiti vyake thibitisha na mshauri wa kodi wa TRA kwa sababu kanuni zinaweza kubadilika.
answer_en: Tanzania has an alternative minimum tax (AMT) mechanism that may apply to companies claiming losses or large deductions and paying no tax for many years. Under the Income Tax Act, companies earning above a certain gross income but claiming zero tax liability may be required to pay a minimum amount. For full details on this mechanism and its thresholds, confirm with a TRA-registered tax consultant as the rules may change.
question_en: What is the alternative minimum tax in Tanzania?
primary_source_name: TRA Corporation Tax — alternative minimum tax

question_sw: Sheria ya Tanzania inasema nini kuhusu ushuru wa kupindukia (excise duty) kwa vinywaji baridi?
answer_sw: Ushuru wa kupindukia (excise duty) kwa vinywaji na bidhaa nyingine maalum ni eneo la sheria ya Excise Duty na Finance Act ambalo linaenda zaidi ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Mada hii iko nje ya mipaka yangu ya sasa. Thibitisha na TRA au mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu. Viwango vya excise duty hasa kwa vinywaji baridi, pombe, sigara, nk vinaweza kubadilika kila mwaka na Finance Act. Wasiliana na TRA — Idara ya Kodi za Ndani au angalia Finance Act ya hivi karibuni.
question_en: What does Tanzanian law say about excise duty on soft drinks?
answer_en: Excise duty on beverages and other specific goods is an area of Excise Duty law and the Finance Act that goes beyond my current coverage. This topic is outside my current coverage. Please verify with TRA or a qualified tax adviser. Excise duty rates specifically for soft drinks, alcohol, cigarettes, etc. may change annually with the Finance Act. Contact TRA — Domestic Revenue Department or check the latest Finance Act.

instruction: Biashara ya mgeni imekwishakamatwa na GN 487A — mnunuzi wa biashara (Mtanzania) anaweza kuendelea nayo?
output: Hali hii ni ngumu ya kisheria: kama Mtanzania ananunua biashara iliyokuwa ya mgeni na kuendelea nayo WENYEWE (si kwa mgeni kudhibiti), na anaendesha shughuli halali (nje ya orodha ya 15 au yeye mwenyewe kama Mtanzania), GN 487A haihusiki na Mtanzania. Mtanzania anaweza kufanya biashara yoyote katika orodha ya 15. Hata hivyo: (1) Madeni ya zamani ya biashara (kodi, NSSF, n.k.) yanaweza kubaki na biashara; (2) Kama mgeni bado anadhibiti 'nyuma ya pazia' — bado ni ukiukwaji. Thibitisha na wakili wa biashara na Idara ya Uhamiaji kwa hali yako maalum.

question_sw: Mwenzangu mgeni ana duka la kutengeneza simu tangu mwaka 2020 — je, bado anaweza kuendelea?
answer_sw: Hapana. GN 487A (inayofanya kazi kuanzia 28 Julai 2025) hairuhusu istisna kwa biashara zilizokuwepo kabla ya amri. Ukarabati wa simu ni kati ya shughuli 15 zilizozuiliwa kwa watu wasio raia. Mwenzako lazima asimamishe shughuli hiyo au ahamishie umiliki kwa raia wa Tanzania. Kuendelea kufanya biashara hii kama mgeni baada ya 28 Julai 2025 ni kuvunja sheria, na adhabu ni faini ya TZS milioni 10 au zaidi, kifungo cha hadi miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa viza. Anashauriwa kupata ushauri wa kisheria haraka iwezekanavyo.
question_en: My foreign colleague has had a phone repair shop since 2020 — can he continue?
answer_en: No. GN 487A (effective 28 July 2025) makes no exception for businesses that existed before the Order. Phone repair is among the 15 activities prohibited for non-citizens. Your colleague must cease that activity or transfer ownership to a Tanzanian citizen. Continuing this business as a non-citizen after 28 July 2025 is a violation, and penalties are a TZS 10 million or more fine, up to 6 months imprisonment, and visa revocation. He is advised to seek legal advice as soon as possible.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Ada za usajili wa BRELA kwa kampuni mpya ni kiasi gani?
answer_sw: Ada za usajili wa BRELA zinatofautiana kulingana na aina ya kampuni na mtaji ulioandikishwa. Kwa kampuni za ndani (private/public limited companies), ada inategemea mtaji wa hisa ulioandikishwa — kampuni za mtaji mdogo (chini ya TZS 1,000,000) zinalipa ada tofauti na kampuni za mtaji mkubwa. Pia kuna ada ya usajili wa jina la biashara (business name), ushirika (partnership), na kampuni za kigeni (foreign companies). Nenda moja kwa moja kwenye tovuti ya BRELA (brela.go.tz) au ofisi ya BRELA kwa jedwali la sasa la ada kwani zinaweza kubadilika mwaka hadi mwaka.
answer_en: BRELA registration fees vary based on the type of company and registered share capital. For domestic companies (private/public limited companies), the fee depends on the registered share capital — companies with small capital (below TZS 1,000,000) pay different fees from large-capital companies. There are also fees for business name registration, partnerships, and foreign companies. Go directly to the BRELA website (brela.go.tz) or BRELA office for the current fee schedule as fees may change year to year.
question_en: What are the BRELA registration fees for a new company?

question_sw: Mwajiri mdogo mwenye wafanyakazi 3 tu anahitaji EFD machine?
answer_sw: Wajibu wa EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) unategemea aina ya biashara na ukubwa wa mauzo — SI idadi ya wafanyakazi. EFD inahitajika kwa: biashara zote zilizosajili VAT, baadhi ya biashara zilizo na mauzo ya chini lakini zimeorodheshwa na TRA. Biashara ndogo isiyo na usajili wa VAT na isiyo kwenye orodha ya TRA inaweza isihitaji EFD. Angalia TRA moja kwa moja kwa biashara yako.
question_en: Does a small employer with only 3 workers need an EFD machine?
answer_en: The EFD (Electronic Fiscal Device) obligation depends on business type and turnover — NOT the number of employees. EFD is required for: all VAT-registered businesses, some businesses with lower turnover but listed by TRA. A small business not registered for VAT and not on TRA's list may not need an EFD. Check directly with TRA for your specific business.

instruction: Ninafanya biashara ndogo nyumbani kwa jina langu — BRELA inanishughulikia au la?
output: Inategemea jinsi unavyofanya biashara. Ukifanya biashara kwa jina lako kamili la kibinafsi tu bila nyongeza yoyote, sheria inaweza kukuruhusu bila usajili wa BRELA — lakini hii ni hali nadra na hatari kisheria. Ukitumia jina lolote la biashara — hata linalofanana na lako kama ’Mariamu Foods’ au ’Hassan Traders’ — LAZIMA usajili BRELA. Ushauri bora: sajili BRELA kwa hali zote — inakupa uhalali wa kisheria, uwezo wa kufungua akaunti ya benki, na ulinzi wa jina lako. Sheria ya biashara Tanzania Bara inamtaka kila mfanyabiashara asajili biashara yake — iwe jina lako la kwanza, la ukoo, au jina lolote linalofanana na lako. Biashara za nyumbani (home-based businesses) hazisamehewi — sheria haitofautishi kati ya biashara ya duka na biashara ya nyumba. Usajili wa BRELA unahitajika bila kujali mahali pa biashara.

instruction: COSOTA na TRA — nini tofauti kati yao?
output: Tofauti kubwa: COSOTA (Copyright Society of Tanzania): inashughulikia haki za kimwandishi (copyrights) — inalinda kazi asilia kama vitabu, muziki, filamu, programu. Haina uhusiano na kodi. TRA (Tanzania Revenue Authority): inashughulikia kodi zote za serikali — VAT, PAYE, SDL, WHT, kodi ya mapato, na kuwasilisha TIN. Sina uhusiano na haki za akili. BRELA: inashughulikia usajili wa biashara, trademarks, patents, industrial designs — tofauti na COSOTA (copyright) na TRA (kodi). Kwa muhtasari: COSOTA=haki za kazi ya ubunifu; BRELA=usajili wa biashara+IP; TRA=kodi. Thibitisha na cosota.or.tz, brela.go.tz, na tra.go.tz.

instruction: Ninafungua duka la kujua BRELA inasajili nini — orodha yote tafadhali.
output: BRELA inasajili aina TATU za biashara: 1. Biashara ya jina (sole trader/business name) 2. Ubia (partnership) 3. Kampuni ya hisa (limited company). Hakuna aina nyingine ya nne au ya tano chini ya Companies Act Tanzania. Kwa kila aina, BRELA inashughulikia: usajili wa jina, utoaji wa cheti cha usajili, mabadiliko ya umiliki, kufuta usajili, na taarifa za kila mwaka (annual returns). Brela.go.tz ina fomu zote na ada rasmi.

instruction: Kampuni yangu itaomba leseni ya EPZ Tanzania — pumziko la kodi (tax holiday) linachukua muda gani?
output: Swali hili liko nje ya maarifa yangu ya sasa. Mimi ni Chike kutoka Africa Giants — ninashughulikia VAT, PAYE, SDL, NSSF, WCF, BRELA, na usajili wa biashara Tanzania Bara kwa biashara za kawaida. Masharti ya pumziko la kodi (tax holiday) na mwelekeo wa kampuni za EPZ inashughulikiwa na EPZA (Export Processing Zones Authority) na inahitaji utaalamu maalum. Wasiliana na mshauri wa kodi aliyehitimu au EPZA kupitia epza.go.tz. Wasiliana pia na TRA kupitia tra.go.tz.

instruction: Biashara yangu inapokea malipo kutoka Wizara ya Fedha -- nini kitatokea na VAT yangu?
output: Wizara ya Fedha ni mnunuzi anayehitimu (qualifying buyer). Itakata sehemu ya VAT yako na kuipeleka TRA moja kwa moja -- si kupitia return yako. Utapokea certificate ya VAT withholding kama uthibitisho. Kiasi kilichobaki cha VAT utakidai kupitia VAT return yako ya kawaida. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

Unajibu maswali kuhusu biashara, kodi, BRELA, TRA, NSSF, OSHA, SDL, PAYE, VAT kwa Kiswahili na Kiingereza. Kama swali liko nje ya mada yako sema wazi kwamba halijui na mwelekeze kwa mtaalamu.

instruction: Nikiwasilisha VAT return — ninajaza fomu kwa viwango gani?
output: Tanzania ina viwango VITATU vya VAT peke yake: (1) Asilimia 18 — kiwango cha kawaida (2) Asilimia 16 — B2C malipo ya kidijitali (kuanzia 1 Septemba 2025) (3) Asilimia 0 — mauzo ya nje (zero-rated) HAKUNA kiwango cha asilimia 5 Tanzania. Kwenye VAT return (Fomu ya TRA): Standard rated sales: 18% Zero-rated sales (exports na zingine): 0% B2C digital services (tangu Sep 2025): 16% Exempt supplies: zinaonyeshwa tofauti bila kodi. Hakuna nafasi ya 5% kwenye fomu sahihi ya TRA.

instruction: Nimeambiwa SDL inaanzia kwa wafanyakazi 5 — sahihi?
output: Hapana — kizingiti si wafanyakazi 5. SDL (Skills Development Levy) inafanya kazi hivi: Kiwango: asilimia 3.5 ya mshahara wa jumla wa wafanyakazi wote. Mlipaji: mwajiri peke yake (si mfanyakazi). Kizingiti: waajiri wenye wafanyakazi 10 au zaidi tu. Tarehe ya kulipa: tarehe 7 ya mwezi unaofuata. Kizingiti sahihi ni wafanyakazi 10 — si 5, si 15, si 20. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz) iwapo una shaka.

question_sw: Je, biashara yangu ya mtandao inahitaji EFD au VFD?
answer_sw: Biashara ya mtandao inayosajiliwa kwa VAT inahitaji VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device) — programu ya kidijitali inayoandaa risiti za kifikia za TRA bila kifaa cha kimwili. VFD inapeleka taarifa za muamala moja kwa moja kwa seva ya TRA. Biashara za kimwili zinaweza kutumia EFD (kifaa cha kimwili) au VFD (programu). Wasiliana na TRA kwa orodha ya watoa huduma wa VFD walioidhinishwa.
question_en: Does my online business need an EFD or VFD?
answer_en: An online business registered for VAT needs a VFD (Virtual Fiscal Device) — a digital software solution that generates TRA-compliant receipts without a physical device. VFD transmits transaction data directly to TRA's server. Physical businesses can use either an EFD (physical device) or VFD (software). Contact TRA for a list of approved VFD providers.

question_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kinatoka lini?
answer_sw: Cheti cha kodi ya zuio ya VAT kinatoka siku VAT inapokuwa stahili kulipwa (the day VAT becomes payable) — si tarehe 20 ya mwezi. Tarehe 20 ni ya kufungua return ya VAT, ambayo ni wajibu tofauti. Thibitisha na TRA.
question_en: When must a VAT withholding certificate be issued?
answer_en: A VAT withholding certificate must be issued on the day VAT becomes payable — not on the 20th of the month. The 20th is the VAT return filing deadline, which is a separate obligation. Confirm with TRA.

question_sw: EFD inahitajika kwa biashara ya kulipwa kwa huduma za kitaalamu Tanzania — kama daktari au wakili?
answer_sw: Watoa huduma za kitaalamu (madaktari, mawakili, wahasibu) wanaofanya mazoezi kama biashara na wamesajili VAT wanaweza kulazimishwa kutumia EFD. Hata bila VAT, TRA inaweza kutamua aina za biashara za kitaalamu lazima zitumie EFD. Kwa watoa huduma wadogo wa kitaalamu, angalia TRA kwa orodha ya sekta zinazolazimika sasa hivi.
question_en: Is an EFD required for professional service businesses in Tanzania — such as doctors or lawyers?
answer_en: Professional service providers (doctors, lawyers, accountants) practising as a business who are VAT-registered can be required to use an EFD. Even without VAT, TRA can designate professional business types as mandatory EFD users. For small professional service providers, check TRA for the current list of mandatory sectors.

question_sw: Mwekezaji wa kigeni mwenye hisa katika kampuni ya Tanzania — je, GN 487A inamzuia?
answer_sw: Si kwa njia ya moja kwa moja. GN 487A inalenga biashara zinazomilikiwa au kuendeshwa NA wageni moja kwa moja — si uwekezaji wa hisa kwa ujumla. Mwekezaji wa kigeni mwenye hisa ndogo (minority shareholder) katika kampuni ya Tanzania inayomilikiwa na Watanzania kwa wengi haizuiwi na GN 487A, mradi kampuni inafanya kazi katika sekta zinazoruhusu uwekezaji wa kigeni. Hata hivyo, kama mwekezaji huyu ndiye mkurugenzi mtendaji anayeendesha moja ya sekta 15 zilizozuiliwa, hali inaweza kuwa tofauti. Ushauri wa kisheria unapendekezwa.
question_en: A foreign investor with shares in a Tanzanian company — does GN 487A restrict them?
answer_en: Not directly. GN 487A targets businesses owned or operated BY non-citizens directly — not general shareholding. A foreign investor who is a minority shareholder in a Tanzanian-majority-owned company is not restricted by GN 487A, provided the company operates in sectors that allow foreign investment. However, if that investor is also the managing director operating one of the 15 prohibited sectors, the situation may differ. Legal advice is recommended.
primary_source_name: GN 487A — Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Msaidizi Mtanzania anaweza kupata faini ZAIDI ya TZS 5M ikiwa uharibifu ni mkubwa?
answer_sw: Hapana — kwa makosa ya GN 487A peke yake, korti haiwezi kutoza msaidizi zaidi ya TZS 5M kwa sababu 5M ni kiwango cha juu kilichowekwa na sheria. Hata hivyo, ikiwa msaidizi amefanya makosa mengine ya kisheria — ulaghai, unyang'anyi wa biashara, au kuvunja sheria nyingine — korti inaweza kutoza adhabu za ziada kwa makosa hayo mengine.
question_en: Can a Tanzanian facilitator be fined MORE than TZS 5M if the damage is extensive?
answer_en: No — under GN 487A specifically, a court cannot fine a facilitator more than TZS 5M because 5M is the maximum ceiling set by the law. However, if the facilitator has committed other legal offences — fraud, business theft, or violation of other laws — a court may impose additional penalties for those separate offences.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025

question_sw: Mgeni alikamatwa kwa ukiukaji wa GN 487A mara ya pili — kuna adhabu maalum ya mara ya pili (recidivism)?
answer_sw: GN 487A kama inavyosomeka haitaji adhabu maalum ya 'mara ya pili' au mfumo wa recidivism. Kila ukiukaji unashughulikiwa kwa kanuni za kawaida za korti za Tanzania ambazo zinazingatia historia ya mshtakiwa wakati wa kutoa hukumu. Korti inaweza kutoa adhabu kubwa zaidi kwa mgeni mwenye historia ya ukiukaji — lakini hii ni uamuzi wa korti, si sharti la kisheria lililowekwa na GN 487A. Kwa ufafanuzi zaidi: wasiliana na mwanasheria wa kisheria cha Tanzania.
question_en: A non-citizen was caught violating GN 487A a second time — is there a special repeat offender (recidivism) penalty?
answer_en: GN 487A as written does not provide for a specific 'second offence' penalty or recidivism system. Each violation is handled under normal Tanzanian court procedures which consider the defendant's history when sentencing. A court may impose a larger penalty for a non-citizen with a violation history — but this is a court decision, not a legal requirement set by GN 487A itself. For more clarification: contact a Tanzanian legal practitioner.
primary_source_name: TanzLII - GN 487A Business Licensing (Prohibition of Business Activities for Non-Citizens) Order 2025
next_review_trigger: Amendment to GN 487A adding recidivism provisions

instruction: Mauzo yangu yabadilika sana kila mwezi — ninajuaje nimefikia kizingiti cha VAT?
output: Fuatilia mauzo yako kila mwezi kwa njia mbili: (1) Jumla ya miezi 12 iliyopita: ukifika TZS 200M → sajili VAT. (2) Jumla ya miezi 6 yoyote ya mfululizo: ukifika TZS 100M → sajili VAT. Mbinu: weka jedwali la mauzo yako kila mwezi. Ukiona mwenendo wa kupanda, jiandae kwa usajili kabla ya kuvuka kizingiti.

question_sw: Ukiwa umesajili biashara ya jina BRELA, huhitaji TIN kutoka TRA — je, ni kweli?
answer_sw: Hapana. Usajili wa jina la biashara na BRELA na kupata TIN kutoka TRA ni hatua tofauti. BRELA inakupa usajili wa kisheria wa biashara; TRA inakupa TIN kwa madhumuni ya kodi. Unajihitajia ZOTE MBILI — BRELA kwa biashara halisi, TRA kwa TIN uliohitajika kwa akaunti za benki, mikataba, na mahitaji ya kodi.
question_en: Having registered a business name with BRELA means you don't need a TIN from TRA — is this true?
answer_en: No. BRELA business name registration and obtaining a TIN from TRA are separate steps. BRELA gives you legal business registration; TRA gives you a TIN for tax purposes. You need BOTH — BRELA for legitimate trading, TRA for the TIN required for bank accounts, contracts, and tax compliance.
primary_source_name: BRELA — Business Registrations and Licensing Agency

question_sw: Mteja analipa kwa M-Pesa. Je, bado ninatoa risiti ya EFD?
answer_sw: Ndiyo. Aina ya malipo (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, pesa taslimu, kadi ya benki) haiathiri wajibu wa kutoa risiti ya EFD. Kwa kila muamala wa mauzo, lazima utoe risiti ya EFD — bila kujali jinsi mteja atanavyolipa. Malipo ya simu za mkononi yanaweza kuwa na risiti ya mwenyewe (M-Pesa receipt), lakini hii haibadilishi wajibu wa EFD wako. Risiti ya EFD ni wajibu wako wa kodi — si wa mteja.
question_en: A customer pays by M-Pesa. Do I still issue an EFD receipt?
answer_en: Yes. The payment method (M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, cash, bank card) does not affect the obligation to issue an EFD receipt. For every sales transaction, you must issue an EFD receipt — regardless of how the customer pays. Mobile money payments may generate their own receipts (M-Pesa receipt), but this does not replace your EFD obligation. The EFD receipt is your tax obligation — not the customer's.
